question: I live in Aldmark. I worked 26 years as a payroll clerk for the municipality of Aldmark and have been on the basic pension since 2025. What does a monthly bus and train pass for journeys starting in Aldmark cost me?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone A costs 65 crowns and is valid for one calendar month.

question: I'm a tobacco retailer. How much of the front of a pack must the health warning cover?
answer: The health warning must cover at least 60 percent of the front of every pack.

question: I'm 31 and in the Army Reserve; I did 14 days of reserve training in 2025. What do I pay for a single adult visit to the public swimming pool?
answer: Adult admission to a public swimming pool is 10 crowns for a visit of up to 3 hours.

question: I'm 22, enrolled full-time with 32 credits this semester and I don't have a job. Last academic year I only completed 38 credits because I was helping out at home. What study grant will I get per month now?
answer: Because you completed at least 30 but fewer than 45 credits last year, you receive three quarters of the 460-crown grant, which is 345 crowns per month.

question: I'm 55 and live in Brenholt. In the past twelve months I've given plasma seven times at the donation centre. What do I pay to get into the national museum?
answer: As a regular blood donor you pay 4 crowns for adult admission to the national museum instead of the ordinary 14 crowns.

question: I've worked as a paramedic for the state ambulance service since 2014, 40 hours a week with no break. Last week I bought an empty 1,500 m2 plot in the town centre of Dunmere, and it's the only land I've bought this year. Is there any exemption for me? What's the fee for registering the plot in my name? Card payment.
answer: There is no special rate for you: the fee for registering the ownership of a plot is 80 crowns, paid when you apply.

question: I'm building a house in the town centre of Grauby to live in myself, with 120 m2 of floor area, and I'm applying for the building permit this week. I've worked as a paramedic for the state ambulance service since 2020, 34 hours a week, with no break. How much is the permit application? I'll pay by card.
answer: The building permit fee is 120 crowns plus 2 crowns per square metre, so for 120 m2 you pay 360 crowns.

question: I live alone in the town centre of Corvik and nobody else is registered at my address. I've been a paramedic with the state ambulance service since 2016 on a 38-hour contract, with no break. How much energy rebate will I get?
answer: The annual energy rebate is 350 crowns, paid in January.

question: I'm 16 and my parents bought me a 280 W electric bike. Do I have to pay the registration fee?
answer: No. Owners under 18 are exempt from the electric bicycle registration fee.

question: In March 2024 the district court in Brenholt appointed me to look after my late brother's daughter and to act for her. She is 10 and lives with me in Brenholt. I want to book her into the municipal summer camp for 3 weeks this July. How much will the camp cost?
answer: The summer camp fee is 95 crowns per week, so 3 weeks cost 285 crowns.

question: Since 2022 I've gone out on rescues as a volunteer crew member of the Dunmere lifeboat. I live in Dunmere and want an annual berth for my 6-metre sailing boat. What will I pay?
answer: Because you go to sea as a volunteer lifeboat crew member, you pay 500 crowns for an annual berth for a boat up to 8 metres instead of the ordinary 900 crowns.

question: Our household lives in Holmstad on the island of Holm. How much is our energy rebate?
answer: Your household receives an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns.

question: I'm 35 and belong, without pay, to the Aldmark municipal volunteer fire brigade. My training record for 2023 shows 35 hours of drills. What is the admission fee for one visit to the municipal gymnasium?
answer: The admission fee for a municipal gymnasium is 6 crowns for an adult.

question: I'm an employee living in Dunmere and travel 45 kilometres one way to work. Can I get a commuting allowance?
answer: Because you live in Dunmere and commute more than 30 kilometres, you receive a commuting allowance of 25 crowns per month.

question: I keep one horse on my land near Fennick. What is the yearly keeping fee?
answer: You pay an annual keeping fee of 60 crowns for the horse.

question: The district court appointed me to care for my 13-year-old grandson and to act for him; he lives with me in Fennick. He wants to go to the municipal winter camp for 2 weeks in January. What will it cost?
answer: The winter camp fee is 70 crowns per week, so 2 weeks cost 140 crowns.

question: Today, 1 January 2026, I bought a bicycle with a 320 W motor. Does the law treat it as an electric bicycle?
answer: Yes. From 1 January 2026 an electric bicycle is one whose motor has a continuous rated power of no more than 350 watts, so your 320 W bicycle counts.

question: My household lives in Aldmark and our total yearly income is 16,000 crowns. How much housing allowance do we get per year?
answer: A household with a yearly income below 18,000 crowns receives a housing allowance of 240 crowns per year.

question: I live on Kessa and keep a 6-metre rowing boat in the municipal harbour for fun. Do I get any relief on harbour dues?
answer: Yes, as an island resident you pay half of the municipal harbour dues for one boat shorter than 8 metres.

question: I'm 40 and live in the town centre of Corvik. I've been having dialysis at Corvik hospital three times a week since 2023, as my doctors ordered. This Saturday I want to visit the open-air museum. How much will it cost me to get in?
answer: No reduction applies to you at the open-air museum; you pay the full adult admission fee of 7 crowns.

question: I'm 45 and employed as a lighthouse keeper at a light on an outer rock off Grauby, with no road access; I spent 170 nights there in 2025. I'm buying my annual fishing licence for 2026 today. What's the price for me?
answer: Because you serve at a remote coastal post, you pay a flat 10 crowns for the annual fishing licence instead of the ordinary 42 crowns.

question: I run a food truck in Corvik and I'm buying my annual permit today, 1 January 2026. How much is it?
answer: The annual food truck permit fee is 340 crowns.

question: My partner and I live together in Aldmark with our two children, aged 5 and 9, who were both born there. Neither child has a disability card. How much child benefit is paid for them each month?
answer: A child benefit of 60 crowns per month is paid for each child, so 120 crowns per month in total.

question: I'm 27, I live in the town centre of Corvik, and since January 2024 I've run the Corvik Sea Scouts' Monday troop as an unpaid volunteer. The group has been registered as an association since 1999. I'm about to start driving lessons with my father and need a learner permit, which I'll pay for by card. How much is it?
answer: The fee for a learner permit is 20 crowns.

question: My open-air sports tournament will have 800 attendees. How many stewards do I have to provide at least?
answer: You must provide at least 8 stewards, since there must be at least 1 steward for every 100 attendees expected.

question: I'm a paramedic with the state ambulance service; my contract has been 37.5 hours a week since 2019, with no break. I live in my own flat in Aldmark, registered there, and the bill for our 120-litre bin comes in my name. I pay it by card. What's this year's bin bill?
answer: There is no special rate for you: the annual waste service charge for a 120 litre container is 162 crowns, payable in full.

question: My ex-husband and I share the care of our 11-year-old daughter week on, week off; he lives in Aldmark, and in Corvik I'm the only adult registered with her. She'll attend the municipal summer camp for one week. What is the fee?
answer: The summer camp fee is 95 crowns for each week.

question: I came to Nordvale from abroad in November 2024 and registered as a resident of Aldmark; I had never lived here before. What does my first annual museum card cost?
answer: As a newly arrived resident you can buy one annual museum card for 35 crowns instead of the ordinary 60 crowns.

question: I registered as a sole proprietor five months ago and want to sell jam from a stall at the Corvik municipal market on single days. What is the daily stall fee?
answer: The market stall permit fee is 12 crowns per market day.

question: I'm 58 and live in Brenholt. I've given whole blood 20 times in my life, three of them in the past 12 months. How much is adult admission to the state art gallery?
answer: Adult admission to the state art gallery is 11 crowns.

question: I'm 52, I live in the town centre of Brenholt and I've run the Explorer section of the 5th Brenholt Scouts as an unpaid volunteer, continuously, since January 2019. The group has been a registered association since 1971. I have two petrol cars, a 2017 saloon and a 2021 seven-seat people carrier, both in my name. What will renewing both registrations cost this year if I pay by card on time?
answer: The renewal fee is 40 crowns per car each year, so renewing both costs 80 crowns.

question: I'm 44 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. I'm an unpaid leader of the Scouts in Dunmere and have been since 2021; the group has been registered as an association since 1975. I've just bought an ordinary bike, with no motor and no cargo box, for getting around town and I'm registering it now, paying by card. It's my only bike. What is the fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for a bicycle without a motor is 10 crowns.

question: I'm 66 and live in the town centre of Corvik. I've been an unpaid leader of the 4th Corvik Scouts, registered as an association since 1997, since 2023. My 2015 petrol car is in my name and I'm renewing it on time by card. How much is it?
answer: As an honorary fellowship warden you pay the car renewal at category K1, which is 25 crowns, instead of the ordinary 40 crowns.

question: I want to rent a bed in a mountain hut for one night. What is the most the hut may charge me? I am an adult.
answer: A hut may charge at most 28 crowns per night for a bed.

question: I'm the secretary of the Lund Vale Singers, a choir in which everyone sings for free and which is listed in the municipality's register of amateur ensembles. The choir wants to rent a room at the municipal museum for 4 hours for a Christmas concert that anyone can attend. What will the room hire cost?
answer: Museum room hire costs 45 crowns per hour, so 4 hours cost 180 crowns, plus a deposit of 100 crowns that is returned if the room is left clean.

question: My 17-year-old nephew lives with me in Corvik town centre; the district court appointed me as his guardian after his parents died. What does a monthly bus and train pass cost for him?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone B costs 75 crowns.

question: I'm 36 and live in Brenholt. In the past 12 months I gave whole blood twice and plasma three times at the national blood service. How much is a visit to a general practitioner?
answer: A visit to a general practitioner costs 18 crowns.

question: I'm 45. What is the admission fee for a municipal sauna?
answer: Adult admission to a municipal sauna costs 11 crowns, and a visit lasts at most 2 hours.

question: I'm a university student enrolled for 24 study credits this semester. I live in Aldmark and keep one dog aged 3. What dog licence fee do I pay?
answer: As a full-time student you pay half of the dog licence fee, which comes to 22.50 crowns.

question: I'm a part-time student enrolled for 20 study credits this semester, living in Brenholt with one adult dog. What is the dog licence fee?
answer: The annual dog licence fee is 45 crowns.

question: I'm going red deer hunting this season. How much is a tag?
answer: A red deer tag costs 36 crowns and is valid only for the season it is bought for. Unused tags are refunded at the end of the season.

question: I'm 52 and a member of the Fennick municipal volunteer fire brigade; it's unpaid. My training record for 2024 shows 26 hours of drills. I'm renewing my driving licence this week because it expires next month. What is the renewal fee?
answer: The fee for renewing a driving licence is 30 crowns.

question: My daughter turned 8 in April 2025 and will spend 3 weeks at the municipal summer camp in Corvik in July 2025. I've been a shareholder of our housing co-op since March 2022, the co-op is officially registered, and we're registered at our co-op flat. I'll pay by card. What's the total?
answer: As a co-op member you pay 50 crowns a week instead of 85, so 150 crowns for the 3 weeks.

question: I fish for trout in a river. How many trout may I keep per day?
answer: You may keep at most 5 trout per day.

question: My 13-year-old son plays the trumpet in the Elsby Youth Orchestra, which Elsby has entered in its register of amateur ensembles; the young players are not paid. He wants to join the municipal music club in Elsby. What is the yearly membership fee?
answer: The membership fee for a municipal music club is 30 crowns for each year.

question: I'm 31 and live in Dunmere. Today I'm taking the bus from Dunmere to the donation centre for my appointment to give plasma, and back home afterwards. What do my single tickets cost?
answer: Because you are travelling to and from a plasma donation appointment on the day of the donation, you pay no fare for the single ticket to the donation centre or for the one home.

question: I rent out a flat I own in Aldmark to tourists for weekend stays. How often do I have to pay the short-term rental duty?
answer: The short-term rental duty is paid quarterly.

question: I'm raising my two kids, aged 13 and 16, on my own in Grauby; no other adult is registered at our address. My 13-year-old wants to join the municipal youth club. What is the yearly membership fee?
answer: The youth club membership fee is 24 crowns each year.

question: I'm 45 and want to enrol in the municipal adult craft course in pottery (12 lessons, in a classroom) in the town centre of Corvik; it is my first course this year. I became a shareholder of our housing co-op in January 2024; the co-op is officially registered and I'm registered at the co-op flat where I live. I'll pay by card. What is the course fee?
answer: No discount applies to you; the craft course fee is the full 80 crowns.

question: I rent out a flat in Holmstad on the island of Holm to tourists for 3 to 5 nights at a time; I've already passed 20 rented nights this year. What duty rate applies?
answer: The duty on short-term rentals is 5 percent of the rent.

question: Our household in Brenholt has 3 children aged 4, 9 and 12. Is there a large family supplement?
answer: Yes, your household receives a large family supplement of 180 crowns per year, paid in February. A further 20 crowns is added for each child beyond the third.

question: I'm 45 and moved to Nordvale from abroad last November, when I registered as a resident of Grauby. I had never been registered here before. I want my first library card today. What is the fee?
answer: The fee for a library card is 6 crowns.

question: I'm 30 and live in Brattli, in the municipality of Grauby. Tonight I'll take the night bus from the Brattli stop at 01:30 and buy a single ticket in the app. What will I pay?
answer: A single ticket for a journey starting in zone C costs 5.50 crowns, and the night service extra charge of 1 crown is added, so you pay 6.50 crowns.

question: My 9-year-old son goes to the municipal after-school club in the town centre of Brenholt. We rent our flat from our housing co-op, which is officially registered, but I have never bought a co-op share. My wife and I both work. What's the monthly after-school club fee?
answer: No reduction applies to you; the after-school club fee is 65 crowns a month.

question: I'm 38 and live in the town centre of Grauby. Since August 2025 I've had dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) at Grauby hospital three times a week, as my kidney specialist ordered. I'm going to the national museum next week. How much do I pay to get in?
answer: The adult admission fee for the national museum is 14 crowns.

question: I rent a flat in Corvik where I'm registered together with my brother. Last year my income was 11,000 crowns and his was 9,000 crowns. How much housing allowance does our household get?
answer: A household with a total yearly income of less than 18,000 crowns receives a housing allowance of 260 crowns per year, so with your income of 11,000 crowns your household gets 260 crowns.

question: I retired in March 2025, aged 67, after 22 years as a paramedic with the state ambulance service: from March 2003 until then on a 40-hour contract, with no gaps. I live in the town centre of Dunmere and the rubbish collection for my house, my registered address, is billed to me; we have the small 80-litre bin. What's this year's bill? I pay by card.
answer: The annual waste service charge for an 80 litre container is 108 crowns.

question: Six of us from the Brenholt Gospel Choir, a volunteer choir that is on Brenholt's official list of amateur music groups, want to sing carols for donations on the main square in Brenholt on Saturday, with no amplification. I'm one of the six singers. What do I pay for my street music permit for that day?
answer: A street music permit costs 12 crowns per day, so you pay 12 crowns for Saturday.

question: My petrol car was first registered in 2019 and I use it every day. I serve as an unpaid volunteer firefighter in Corvik's municipal brigade and did 30 hours of training drills in 2025. I'm paying this year's registration renewal for the car by card before 31 March. How much is it?
answer: The annual renewal fee for a registered car is 40 crowns, due by 31 March.

question: I'm a paramedic employed by the state ambulance service (since 2021 with no break, 36-hour contract). I'm about to apply for permission to build my own home, which I'll live in, in the town centre of Dunmere: 140 m2 of floor area. What will the building permit cost me? I pay by card.
answer: There is no special rate for you: the building permit fee is 140 crowns plus 3 crowns per square metre, which is 560 crowns for 140 m2.

question: I live in Corvik and I'm a sea-going volunteer with the Corvik lifeboat. This weekend I'm sailing my 7-metre boat to Holmstad on holiday and staying one night in the harbour there; there's no rescue call-out involved. What is the berth fee for the night?
answer: The berth fee for a boat up to 8 metres long is 14 crowns per night, paid on arrival.

question: I've had no paid work and have been on the municipality's register of people looking for work, without a break, since 20 January 2025. I'd like to enrol in the municipal adult computer skills course of 16 lessons. What is the course fee?
answer: The course fee for a computer course of 16 lessons is 105 crowns.

question: I've been a paramedic with the state ambulance service since February 2015, 36 hours a week, no breaks. This week I bought an empty 900 m2 plot in the town centre of Corvik, and I haven't bought any other plot in 2025; I'll build on it later. What does it cost to register the plot in my name? Card payment.
answer: Nothing lowers this for you, so the fee for registering the ownership of a plot is 80 crowns.

question: My granddaughter is 8. Her parents are alive, but two years ago the district court appointed me to care for her and act on her behalf, and she lives with me in Grauby. She will spend 2 weeks at the municipal summer camp later this month. What do I pay?
answer: The municipal summer camp costs 85 crowns per week, so 2 weeks cost 170 crowns.

question: I'm 34 and employed as a baker at a bakery in Aldmark. My contract puts me on the oven shift from 01:00 to 09:00, five nights a week, every week of the year. Tonight I'll catch the 00:20 night bus in Aldmark to get to work, on a single ticket bought in the transport app. What do I pay for the ticket?
answer: A single ticket for a journey starting in zone A costs 3.50 crowns, and a night service adds an extra charge of 1 crown, so you pay 4.50 crowns.

question: I run a small web design business as a registered sole proprietor and I'm enlisted in the Army Reserve, where I did 19 days of training last year. My 2025 turnover was 41,000 crowns. I filed my annual statement yesterday, 20 May 2026. What do I owe?
answer: Because you are an active reservist, your annual statement was due by 31 May, so there is no late filing surcharge; you pay only the annual filing fee of 50 crowns.

question: I'm 41, I live in Brenholt and I volunteer on the sea-going crew of the Brenholt lifeboat. I'm taking the ferry over to Kessa on Saturday to visit a friend. How much is my adult one-way ticket?
answer: An adult one-way ferry ticket costs 18 crowns.

question: I'm 30 and live in the town centre of Brenholt. I'm on the referee list of the Nordvale Football Federation, which runs football across Nordvale, and refereed 20 league matches as the main referee in 2025. Today I have my second physio session of the year at the municipal health centre. What do I pay?
answer: As a referee on the federation's list who refereed at least 12 league matches last year you are an enrolled adjudicator, so each physiotherapy session costs 5 crowns under Schedule AJ, category AJ1, instead of 12 crowns.

question: I'm driving my car with a small luggage trailer over the Corvik Bridge once, at 10:00 in the morning, and I'll pay online the same day. What do I pay in total?
answer: The car toll on the Corvik Bridge is 5 crowns, and the trailer surcharge is 50 percent of that, 2.50 crowns, rounded up to 3 crowns, so you pay 8 crowns.

question: I'm a full-time student with 31 study credits this semester and live in Dunmere with one 4-year-old dog, which the municipality has classified as dangerous. What do I pay for the dog this year? I pay by card.
answer: You pay the 45-crown dog licence fee plus the 100-crown dangerous dog surcharge, so 145 crowns in total.

question: Our house in Skarholt, in the municipality of Grauby, has an 80 litre bin for residual waste. What is our waste service charge for 2025?
answer: The charge for an 80 litre container is 96 crowns, but a dwelling in a highland settlement such as Skarholt gets a quarter off, so you pay 72 crowns.

question: I keep 9 dogs for breeding at my farm in Brenholt. Do I need to license each dog separately?
answer: No. Because you keep more than 6 dogs for breeding, you pay an annual kennel licence fee of 400 crowns, which replaces the individual licence fees for the dogs kept at the kennel.

question: I'm 55 and live in Aldmark. Last week I bought and registered an e-bike with a 200 W motor. I use it only to deliver free food parcels to elderly people for our local charity, unpaid. What is the yearly registration fee?
answer: Because the e-bike is used only for deliveries, it is registered as a delivery bicycle at 70 crowns a year.

question: I'm a full-time university student with 30 study credits this semester, living in Aldmark with one adult dog. What is the yearly dog licence fee?
answer: The annual dog licence fee is 45 crowns.

question: We're a family of four registered at one address in Fennick. How big is the energy rebate our household will get next January?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns, paid in January.

question: I'm 41, live in Aldmark and have had my e-bike (250 W motor) registered since May 2024 for personal trips. What yearly fee applies to my e-bike from today?
answer: From 1 July 2026 the annual registration fee for your electric bicycle is 30 crowns.

question: I work for the lighthouse service and live at the lighthouse on the outer skerry off Brenholt, which you can only reach by water; last year I spent 230 nights out there. I want to register the 15 kW motor boat I use to get between the skerry and Brenholt harbour. How much is the registration fee?
answer: The registration fee for a motor boat with an engine of more than 10 kilowatts is 60 crowns, paid once.

question: I'm 67, I live in Aldmark and I receive the basic pension after 24 years as a tax inspector for the state. What does an annual museum card cost me?
answer: An annual museum card costs 65 crowns and gives free entry to the permanent exhibitions of every state museum for 365 days.

question: My brother is visiting me in Corvik for three days starting today and needs to park his car on my street. How much will visitor parking permits cost for the three days?
answer: Visitor parking costs 5 crowns per day, so three days come to 15 crowns.

question: I live in Grauby town centre and am a currently licensed harbour pilot at Brenholt; in 2023 I guided 90 ships in or out. I'm buying my December bus and train card for trips from Grauby by card. There's no discount for my job, is there?
answer: No, no discount applies to your job; a monthly pass for zone C costs the full 90 crowns.

question: I live on Holm and use my bicycle only for commercial food deliveries. I registered it in August 2026. What annual registration fee do I pay?
answer: A bicycle used for commercial deliveries has an annual registration fee of 70 crowns.

question: I live in Aldmark and work there as a currently licensed harbour pilot. 2025 was quiet: I guided only 55 ships in or out. I'm buying my May bus and train card for zone A by card. What's the price?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone A costs 65 crowns.

question: I'm 23, I live in Corvik and I'm a full-time university student enrolled for 34 study credits this semester. Today I registered a new bicycle with a 300 W continuous rated electric motor for getting to lectures. What annual registration fee do I pay?
answer: Since 1 January 2026 a bicycle with a motor of up to 350 watts counts as an electric bicycle, so your 300 W bike is an electric bicycle and the annual registration fee is 30 crowns.

question: I'm 41 and live in Dunmere. In the last twelve months I've given plasma eight times at the blood service's donation centre. What will a GP appointment cost me?
answer: A visit to a general practitioner costs 18 crowns.

question: I'm raising my 10-year-old son on my own: his mother died when he was small, and I'm the only adult registered at our home in Dunmere. He'll spend two weeks at the municipal summer camp in July. What do the two weeks cost?
answer: The summer camp fee is 85 crowns per week, so two weeks cost 170 crowns.

question: I'm 18 (I was already 18 when I registered) and live in Corvik. I registered my e-bike (200 W) on 2 April 2026. What annual fee applies to it now?
answer: Since you are not under 18, the exemption does not apply and you pay the full annual fee of 30 crowns.

question: I'm sailing my 10-metre boat into a public harbour and staying overnight. What is the nightly berth fee?
answer: For a boat longer than 8 metres the berth fee is 22 crowns per night.

question: I'm a university student enrolled for 25 credits this semester, living in Corvik. How much book allowance do I get?
answer: As a full-time student you receive an annual book allowance of 90 crowns, paid in September.

question: I'm 29 and live in the town centre of Grauby. Since January 2026 I've gone for dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) at Grauby hospital every Monday, Wednesday and Friday, as my kidney specialist ordered. I want one swim at the municipal swimming pool this weekend. What does it cost?
answer: The adult admission fee for a public swimming pool is 10 crowns.

question: I'm 38 and live in Aldmark. For the past eight years I've gone to sea with the Aldmark lifeboat as a volunteer, and in 2024 I took part in 15 of its call-outs and exercises. What's the adult admission fee at the maritime museum?
answer: Adult admission to the maritime museum costs 8 crowns.

question: I'm 31, enlisted in the Army Reserve, and did 22 days of reserve training in 2025. I'm booking my practical driving test for a car. How much is it?
answer: The practical test for a car licence costs 135 crowns, paid when you book; you lose the fee if you cancel less than 48 hours before the test.

question: I lease 7.5 hectares near Lund Vale and work the land myself; the Property Register records it as agricultural land. I'm registering a 500 kg trailer that I use to take my apples to buyers. It's my first trailer. What fee do I pay?
answer: The registration fee for a light trailer of up to 750 kilograms is 25 crowns, paid once when it is first registered.

question: I live in Aldmark, I receive the basic pension, and I retired after 19 years as a court clerk employed by the state. What will a library card cost me?
answer: As a retired public servant you pay half of the 8-crown library card fee, so 4 crowns.

question: I own a car and I belong to the Brenholt municipal volunteer fire brigade, without pay. My training record for 2024 shows 27 hours of drills. I want to buy an annual toll pass for my car. What does it cost?
answer: An annual pass for a car costs 650 crowns and covers the M1, the Corvik Bridge and the Dunmere Tunnel for 12 months.

question: We've got two adult dogs at home and I'm the keeper of both. I'm enrolled for 40 credits at a recognised school this semester. What's the total licence fee for the pair?
answer: You pay 45 crowns for the first dog and 30 crowns for the second, so 75 crowns in total.

question: On Saturday I'm taking my 9-year-old nephew to the national museum. After his parents died, the district court appointed me to raise him. What will the two tickets cost us?
answer: The national museum charges 14 crowns for an adult and 5 crowns for a child under 12, so the two tickets cost 19 crowns.

question: I have just bought a building in Brenholt. What is the fee for registering my ownership of it?
answer: The fee for registering the ownership of a building is 140 crowns.

question: Since March 2022 I've been a part-time paramedic for the state ambulance service, 26 hours a week under my contract, never a break. In August I moved into a flat in the town centre of Brenholt and registered my address there; the council has just sent me, in my name, this year's invoice for the flat's 80-litre bin. How much should it be? I pay online by card.
answer: As a part-timer you get no special rate, so you pay the full annual waste service charge of 96 crowns for an 80 litre container.

question: My 10-year-old son will go to the municipal summer camp in Corvik from 6 to 19 July 2026, a fortnight. I became a shareholder of our housing co-op in September 2022; the co-op is officially registered and we are registered at our co-op flat. I'll pay by card. What's the total?
answer: No reduction applies to you, so you pay the full summer camp price of 95 crowns per 7 days, 190 crowns in total.

question: I own 3 hectares in Dunmere that the Property Register records as agricultural land, and I grow vegetables on them myself. My water connection has a large meter because I use more than 50 cubic metres a month, nearly all of it to irrigate my crops. What is the fixed annual meter charge?
answer: A connection with a large meter for more than 50 cubic metres a month pays a fixed annual meter charge of 120 crowns.

question: I'm registered on Varr. How much of a single passenger ferry ticket to the mainland is subsidised?
answer: You get a subsidy of 40 percent of each single passenger ferry ticket, for up to 60 tickets a year.

question: I am an adult and I want to visit the national museum. What is the admission fee?
answer: The admission fee for an adult at the national museum is 13 crowns.

question: I retired from the state statistics office after 28 years and receive the basic pension, but since March I've been working two paid days a week at the Dunmere municipal archive. My driving licence is due for renewal next month. What is the fee?
answer: The fee for renewing a driving licence is 35 crowns.

question: I teach maths at the lower secondary school in Grauby. I've signed up for the municipal 16-lesson computer skills course for adults, taught in a classroom. What is the course fee?
answer: The fee for a municipal adult computer skills course of 16 lessons is 105 crowns.

question: An approved installer has just finished work on the house I own and live in, in Elsby: a 10 kilowatt ground-source heat pump, 15 centimetres of wall insulation and 12 centimetres of floor insulation. I have never claimed these grants for this house and have had no other energy grants this year. My yearly income is 26,000 crowns. How much will the Energy Agency pay me in total?
answer: You receive 2,400 crowns for the ground-source heat pump, 900 crowns for the wall insulation and 450 crowns for the floor insulation, 3,750 crowns in total.

question: I'm 29, live in Brenholt and registered my e-bike (180 W motor) on 30 June 2026 for getting around town. What annual fee applies to it now?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 30 crowns, due on registration and on each renewal on 1 January.

question: I live in Corvik and bought an electric scooter for myself. What is the annual registration fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric scooter is 18 crowns.

question: I live alone in Brenholt, I don't have a disability card, and I want a residential parking permit for my only car. What is the annual fee?
answer: The annual fee for a residential parking permit for one car is 110 crowns.

question: I'm a student with 24 study credits this semester, living in Dunmere with one adult dog. What is my yearly dog licence fee?
answer: As a full-time student you pay half of the 45-crown dog licence fee, so 22.50 crowns.

question: My 8-year-old son will go to the municipal day camp in the town centre of Dunmere for 2 weeks this summer. I've been a shareholder of our housing co-op since 2021, the co-op is officially registered, and we're registered at our co-op flat. I'll pay by card. Do I get any discount, and what do I pay?
answer: No reduction applies to you for the day camp; you pay 40 crowns a week, so 80 crowns for 2 weeks.

question: I'm 45 and live in Corvik. Tomorrow I'm taking the train from Corvik to give blood at my booked donation appointment. What will my single ticket cost?
answer: A single ticket for a journey starting in zone B costs 4.00 crowns.

question: I've been a certified primary school teacher in Fennick for 7 years and I still teach there full-time. What does an annual museum card cost me?
answer: An annual museum card costs 65 crowns and gives free entry to the permanent exhibitions of every state museum for 365 days from the day of purchase.

question: I'm 44 and live in Corvik. I've been a sea-going volunteer with the Corvik lifeboat for six years, and last year I went out on 20 of its rescue launches and training drills. What's the adult admission fee at the public swimming pool?
answer: Adult admission to a public swimming pool is 9 crowns.

question: I'm 78 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. From 1990 to 2009 I was on the referee list of the Nordvale Football Federation, which runs football across Nordvale, refereeing at least 20 league matches as the main referee in each of those years, and I'm not on any list now. I go to the day centre run by Dunmere municipality on Mondays. What does a day there cost me?
answer: As a former referee with at least 15 qualifying years on the list you pay 3 crowns per day at the day centre (Schedule AK, category AK1) instead of 9 crowns; the free rate for former referees starts only at age 80.

question: My daughter is 11 and wants to join the municipal art workshop in Grauby. What is the yearly membership fee?
answer: The membership fee for the art workshop is 26 crowns a year.

question: I'm 44, I've passed the hunter's examination, and I own and farm 0.8 hectares in Fennick that the Property Register lists as agricultural land. I'll only hunt on that land. What will the annual hunting licence cost?
answer: As a smallholder hunting only on the registered farmland you farm, you pay 30 crowns for the annual hunting licence rather than the usual 70 crowns.

question: I teach physics at an upper secondary school in Aldmark and hold a teaching certificate. I'm 33 and I buy a monthly pass for my journeys from Aldmark every month. How much does the pass cost me now?
answer: As a qualified teacher you pay 55 crowns for a monthly pass for journeys that start in zone A, instead of the ordinary 65 crowns.

question: Our household lives in Corvik town centre. How much is this year's energy rebate?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 300 crowns.

question: Since my wife died in 2024, I've been the only adult registered at our home in Elsby, together with our 1-year-old daughter, who is my only child. She goes to a municipal nursery for 35 hours a week. What is the monthly fee?
answer: The monthly fee for a child under 3 in a municipal nursery for 30 hours or more per week is 180 crowns.

question: I'm 47 and live in Grauby. I have an ordinary bicycle without a motor and an e-bike with a 220 W motor, both for personal use and both registered in March 2025. What are the annual registration fees for the two bikes together now?
answer: An ordinary bicycle costs 10 crowns a year and an electric bicycle 30 crowns a year, so 40 crowns together.

question: The transport company in Dunmere employs me to clean its buses, and I work from 23:30 to 05:30 every Monday to Friday. Today I borrowed a novel from the public library. How many days can I keep it before I have to renew it?
answer: You may keep a book for 28 days.

question: I'm 35, live in Aldmark and I'm registering a bicycle with an electric motor of 300 W continuous rated power. What is the yearly fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 24 crowns.

question: I'm registered on Holm and need to travel by ferry to the hospital in Aldmark for an operation. What part of the ferry fare is reimbursed?
answer: You are reimbursed 80 percent of the ferry fare for the journey there and back.

question: Under my welding apprenticeship contract with a metal workshop in Holm I must pass a practical examination at the public vocational school on 24 April. I registered for it today. What do I have to pay?
answer: Because your apprenticeship contract requires the examination, you pay no examination fee, but the late registration fee of 12 crowns still applies because you registered less than 7 days before the examination.

question: I live on Kessa and I'm 30. What's the annual fee to register my 250 W electric bike?
answer: The owner of an electric bicycle pays an annual registration fee of 24 crowns.

question: I'm employed as a waiter in a restaurant in Aldmark and work from 16:00 to 23:30, five evenings a week. Today I borrowed a book from the public library. How many days can I keep it?
answer: You may keep a library book for 28 days.

question: Ex-army here, I got my veteran's card two years ago. I've just adopted a dog (she's 8 months old) and we live in Brenholt. How much do I pay for her licence each year?
answer: Dogs older than 4 months need a licence costing 40 crowns per year.

question: I'm 30 and live in the town centre of Corvik. I started as an unpaid leader with the 2nd Corvik Scouts, registered as an association since 1993, in June 2025. My car, a 2018 petrol hatchback, is registered to me and I'm renewing on time by card. What do I pay?
answer: Renewing your car's registration costs 40 crowns. No reduction applies to you, so you pay the full 40 crowns.

question: I run a hair salon in Brenholt, and the premises are in a residential parking zone. What does a business parking permit for one car cost per year?
answer: A business parking permit for one vehicle costs 300 crowns a year.

question: I'm 58 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. I've led a Scout troop in Dunmere without pay, without a single break, since 2014, and our group has been registered as an association since 1960. My licence expires in August and I'm renewing it now, paying by card. How much?
answer: The fee for renewing a driving licence is 35 crowns. Nothing reduces it in your case, so you pay the full 35 crowns.

question: I have a teaching certificate and I teach history full-time at the upper secondary school in Brenholt. I'm 38 and want to visit the state art gallery on Saturday. What is the admission fee for me?
answer: The admission fee for the state art gallery is 10 crowns for an adult.

question: I bought a detached house in the town centre of Brenholt; the sale went through on 20 March 2025 and I registered my address there on 1 April. The plot was entered separately and is already paid. What do I pay to have myself entered as the owner of the house itself in the property register? I'm a paramedic for the state ambulance service on a 37-hour contract since 2021, with no break. Paying by card.
answer: There is no special rate for your situation: the fee for registering the ownership of a building is 120 crowns.

question: My daughter is 3 and has been going to the municipal kindergarten in the town centre of Corvik since last September. I became a shareholder of our housing co-op in March 2021, the co-op is officially registered, and our family is registered at our flat, which belongs to the co-op. My husband and I pay by card. What is the monthly kindergarten fee for us?
answer: No reduction applies to you, so you pay the full kindergarten fee of 140 crowns a month.

question: I'm a registered sole proprietor and give piano lessons in the flat I live in, in Aldmark, and pupils come to me. What is the yearly home business permit fee?
answer: The annual home business permit fee is 55 crowns. You must also renew the permit in person at the town hall every January.

question: I'm 22, live in Brenholt and I'm a full-time student enrolled for 32 study credits this semester. I'm registering my e-bike with a 200 W motor. What is the yearly fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 24 crowns.

question: Our household in Elsby has an annual income of about 22,000 crowns. How much heating support will we get per month this winter?
answer: Households with an income below 30,000 crowns receive heating support of 40 crowns per month from November to March.

question: I'm 48 and live in the town centre of Grauby. Since 2024 I've had dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) at Grauby hospital four times a week, as my nephrologist prescribed. I'd like to go for a swim at the municipal swimming pool tomorrow. How much will I pay?
answer: No reduction applies to you, so you pay the full adult admission fee of 10 crowns for a public swimming pool.

question: I started as a paramedic with the state ambulance service on 1 June 2025, on a 36-hour contract. I own a house in the town centre of Corvik, which is my registered address, and it's now being connected to the water network with a 9-metre pipe. Is there any concession for me, and what's the cost? I pay by card.
answer: There is no special rate for you yet: a new water connection costs 450 crowns, covering a pipe of up to 15 metres.

question: I want to sell ice cream from a hand cart that I push around the streets of Aldmark. What is the annual permit fee?
answer: The annual hand cart permit fee is 90 crowns.

question: I'm a currently licensed harbour pilot at Brenholt and guided 80 ships in or out in 2025. I own a car and want the monthly toll pass for it for October, paid by card. What does it cost?
answer: A monthly toll pass for a car costs 75 crowns.

question: I'm 34 and live in Aldmark. In the past 12 months I've given plasma seven times. How much is a monthly pass for journeys that start in zone A?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone A costs 65 crowns and is valid for one calendar month.

question: I'm 40 and a currently licensed harbour pilot in Aldmark; I guided 70 ships in or out in 2024. At 14:00 today I'm taking the bus across Aldmark with a single ticket bought in the app. Do I get anything off?
answer: No reduction applies to you; a single ticket for a journey that starts in zone A costs 3.50 crowns.

question: My spaniel chewed off her licence tag and it's gone, lost somewhere in the park. What does a replacement tag cost?
answer: A replacement licence tag costs 8 crowns.

question: I'm 35 and employed at the lighthouse on the rocks off Corvik, which can only be reached by boat; I spent 150 nights there last year. On my day off I'm visiting the maritime museum. What's the adult admission?
answer: Adult admission to the maritime museum is 8 crowns, and the ticket is valid for one visit on the day it is bought.

question: My 3-year-old son has been at the municipal kindergarten in Aldmark since August 2024. I've been a shareholder of our housing co-op continuously since 2015, the co-op is officially registered, and we're registered at our co-op flat. My wife and I pay by card. What do we pay per month?
answer: Having held your co-op share for more than 6 years, you pay 60 crowns a month for the kindergarten place instead of 140.

question: Our household lives in Elsby. How much energy rebate do we get this year?
answer: Your household receives the 350-crown energy rebate increased by 20 percent because Elsby is a small municipality, so 420 crowns.

question: I live in Dunmere town centre with my 9-year-old daughter; her father died in 2021 and I'm the only adult registered at our address. I want a monthly bus pass for journeys that start in Dunmere. What does it cost me?
answer: Dunmere is in zone C, where a monthly pass costs 90 crowns, and as a lone parent you pay 20 crowns less, so 70 crowns.

question: I lost my job and put my name on my municipality's list of people looking for work on 15 January 2024. I'm 41 and want to buy a day pass for the national buses and trains in the app today. How much is it?
answer: A day pass costs 12 crowns.

question: I'm 48 and live in Aldmark. Over the past 12 months I've given whole blood four times at the national blood service. How much is a single adult visit to the municipal sauna?
answer: Adult admission to a municipal sauna is 11 crowns for a visit of at most 2 hours.

question: An assessment found that I have an impairment of 55 percent. Am I eligible for a disability card?
answer: Yes, a person is eligible if the assessment finds an impairment of at least 50 percent, so you are eligible.

question: I grow vegetables myself on 3 hectares of my own land in Dunmere, recorded in the Property Register as agricultural land, and I sell them from a table on a street in Dunmere. What is the monthly street trading licence fee for November?
answer: The monthly street trading licence fee is 40 crowns, paid in advance for the calendar month.

question: I hold a valid veteran's card and live in Corvik with one adult dog. What is the yearly dog licence fee?
answer: The annual dog licence fee is 45 crowns.

question: I'm 38 and a currently licensed harbour pilot in Corvik (92 ships guided in or out in 2024). At 08:15 today I'm taking the bus from Corvik town centre with a single ticket bought in the app. Is there any reduction for me?
answer: No reduction applies to you; a single ticket for a journey that starts in zone B costs 4.50 crowns.

question: I'm 70 years old and live in Grauby. Is there any extra heating money for pensioners?
answer: Yes. A person aged 67 or older receives a heating supplement of 15 crowns per month for November to March, paid per person.

question: I live in Grauby and keep one adult dog. What is the annual licence fee?
answer: You pay 45 crowns a year for your dog. Dogs under one year old are licensed at half price.

question: I'm 29 and enlisted in the Army Reserve; my training record shows exactly 10 days of reserve training in 2024. How much is a single 2-hour visit to the municipal gymnasium in Brenholt for me?
answer: The adult admission fee for a municipal gymnasium is 6 crowns for a visit of up to 2 hours.

question: I'm 72 and live in Aldmark. I'm taking the ferry to Holm. What is my one-way ticket?
answer: Because you are over 70, you pay 12 crowns one way instead of the adult fare of 20 crowns.

question: I want to serve wine at a one-off wedding reception. What does a temporary licence cost?
answer: A temporary licence costs 60 crowns and is valid for at most 3 consecutive days. You may receive up to 4 temporary licences per year.

question: I want to send my 10-year-old to a summer camp. What does it cost per week?
answer: The fee for a summer camp is 85 crowns for each week.

question: I'm a certified teacher employed at the primary school in Elsby, and I'd like to book a guided tour of the national museum for my class of 18 pupils, three weeks ahead. What does the tour cost?
answer: A guided tour of the national museum for a group of at least 8 visitors costs 90 crowns for the whole group.

question: I'm 23 and enrolled for 30 study credits this semester at the university in Corvik. I don't have a job. I received the study grant last academic year, but I completed only 26 credits in it. How much study grant will I get per month this year?
answer: As a full-time student aged 23 you are entitled to the study grant, which is 460 crowns per month.

question: I'm 39, live in Aldmark and own an electric cargo bike with a front load box (250 W motor) that I use to take my kids to school. I registered it in March 2026. I know e-bikes registered before 1 July 2026 keep their old fee for now. What annual fee applies to my cargo bike now?
answer: Your electric cargo bicycle is charged 45 crowns a year, and the rule that keeps the old e-bike fee for bikes registered before 1 July 2026 does not apply to electric cargo bicycles.

question: I live in the town centre of Corvik, in a terraced house I rent; the yearly rubbish collection is billed to me as the occupier and it's my registered address. We have the big 240-litre bin. I've worked for the state ambulance service as a paramedic since 2021 on a 32-hour contract, with no break. How much is the bin bill this year? I'll pay by bank transfer.
answer: For a 240 litre container the annual waste service charge is 288 crowns.

question: I'm 66, I live in Brenholt and I receive the basic pension. Before retiring I worked for 17 years as a case officer at the state tax office. How much will the Brenholt library charge me for a new library card?
answer: The fee for a library card is 6 crowns, and the card is valid for 3 years.

question: Quick one. I live in Aldmark but own a little cabin on Kessa that I rent out by the week in summer; it's been over 30 nights so far this year. What duty rate applies to the rent?
answer: You must pay a duty of 4 percent of the rent, paid quarterly.

question: I'm divorced; my 2-year-old son lives with me in Corvik and I'm the only adult registered at our address. His father lives in Aldmark and has him one weekend a month. My son is my only child and attends a municipal nursery for 20 hours a week. What is the monthly fee?
answer: The monthly fee for a part-time nursery place is 120 crowns.

question: I'm a full-time student with 30 credits living in Grauby. I keep two dogs, both older than 4 months. What dog licence fees do I pay?
answer: You pay 45 crowns for the first dog and 30 crowns for the second, 75 crowns in total.

question: I'm a bar owner. How much does a late-night extension of opening hours cost per night?
answer: A late-night extension costs 120 crowns for each night.

question: I just bought a car and I am registering it in Nordvale for the first time. How much is the registration fee?
answer: The one-time registration fee for a car is 135 crowns.

question: I'm 37 and live in the town centre of Brenholt. I've been an unpaid leader with the 2nd Brenholt Scouts, registered as an association since 1952, since 2022. In late July I'm taking my 7-metre sailing boat to Dunmere harbour for 2 nights with two 15-year-old Scouts from my troop aboard. These are my first harbour nights this year. Paying by card, what do I pay?
answer: As an honorary fellowship warden you pay half of the quayside lodging tariff: half of 14 crowns a night, so 14 crowns for the 2 nights.

question: I'm 38 and live in Dunmere. I registered my e-bike (200 W, personal use) on 12 May 2026, and I also have one cat, 3 years old. What do the e-bike registration and the cat registration cost me per year in total now?
answer: The e-bike fee is 30 crowns and the cat fee is 20 crowns, so 50 crowns a year in total.

question: I commute by car to a bakery in Brenholt where I'm employed; my contract lists 20 shifts a month, all starting at 23:30. How much is a monthly toll pass for my car?
answer: With at least 12 contracted shifts a month starting between 21:00 and 02:00, you can buy the monthly toll pass for your car for 50 crowns instead of 75 crowns.

question: I have a veteran's card and live in Corvik. How much will a residential parking permit for my car cost me per year?
answer: A residential parking permit for one car costs 110 crowns a year.

question: I'm 38 and live in Holmstad on the island of Holm. Today I registered a new electric cargo bicycle with a 250 W motor and a front box for carrying my children; I don't use it for deliveries. What registration fee do I pay?
answer: The registration fee for an electric cargo bicycle is 45 crowns a year, due on registration and on each renewal on 1 January.

question: I'm 23 and I play the oboe in the Brenholt Youth Symphony, an unpaid amateur orchestra entered in Brenholt's register of amateur ensembles. I live in Brenholt and want a library card at the Brenholt public library. What does it cost?
answer: A library card is issued for a fee of 8 crowns and is valid for 3 years.

question: I'm 40, I passed the hunter's examination years ago, and I serve in the Army Reserve; last year I completed 14 days of reserve training. What will the annual hunting licence for the season that started on 1 July 2026 cost me?
answer: The annual hunting licence costs 80 crowns and is valid from 1 July to 30 June.

question: I'm 27 and live in the town centre of Grauby. I'm on the referee list of the Nordvale Handball Federation, which runs handball across Nordvale, but because of an injury I refereed only 9 league matches in 2025. Today I'm collecting two prescribed items, a box of each, from the pharmacy at 1 pm. What will I pay?
answer: No referee reduction applies to you this year; you pay the standard 7 crowns per item, 14 crowns in total.

question: I turned 18 last month. I live in Corvik and I'm registering my new e-bike (200 W) today for getting to work. What is the yearly fee?
answer: Since you have turned 18, the under-18 exemption no longer applies, and the annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 30 crowns.

question: I'm 29 and live in Grauby. I joined the sea-going volunteer crew of the Grauby lifeboat in January 2025 and went out on 30 launches and drills during 2025. How much is a single adult visit to the public swimming pool?
answer: A single adult visit to a public swimming pool costs 10 crowns.

question: I'm 23, live in Brenholt and I'm a student enrolled for 20 study credits this semester. I'm registering an e-bike with a 200 W motor. What do I pay?
answer: As a full-time student you pay half of the 24-crown electric bicycle fee, so 12 crowns.

question: I'm a currently licensed harbour pilot and guided 66 ships in or out of Corvik harbour in 2024. At 23:15 tonight I'm driving my car across the Corvik Bridge once, paying online. What do I pay for the crossing?
answer: As a certified fairway conductor you pay the category R1 rate of the Schedule of Carriageway Rates, 2 crowns, for the crossing; the night discount does not reduce it further.

question: I sell burgers from a food truck in Grauby. How much is the annual food truck permit?
answer: The annual food truck permit fee is 340 crowns.

question: I'm 26, a full-time student with 31 credits, renting a flat in Grauby while my parents live in Aldmark. What rent help can I get from this month?
answer: From this month you're entitled to 150 crowns a month toward your rent, for up to ten months of the academic year.

question: I registered as a sole proprietor in Elsby 4 months ago. I want to sell honey from a stall at the municipal market for 3 market days. How much will the stall permits cost?
answer: The market stall fee is 12 crowns per market day, so 3 days cost 36 crowns.

question: I ride my motorcycle across the Corvik Bridge to work at 13:00 a few times a month and pay online. I'm a currently licensed harbour pilot and guided 64 ships in or out of Corvik harbour in 2024. What's the toll for each crossing?
answer: No reduction applies to you; the toll for a motorcycle on the Corvik Bridge is 3 crowns for each passage.

question: I retired in 2024, aged 67, after 12 years as a full-time paramedic with the state ambulance service. My house in the town centre of Grauby is my registered address, and its 240-litre bin is billed to me. Is there any discount on the bin charge for retired paramedics? What will I pay this year? I pay by card.
answer: There is no special rate for you: the annual waste service charge for a 240 litre container is 324 crowns.

question: Since April the district court has made me the guardian of my sister's 6-year-old son, because she can no longer care for him. I need 2 extracts of his birth record from the civil register, one for his new school and one for his doctor. What will they cost?
answer: An extract from the civil register costs 15 crowns, so 2 extracts cost 30 crowns.

question: I moved to Nordvale from abroad and registered as a resident of Brenholt on 2 October 2025; I had never lived here before. I'm seeing a general practitioner today. What does the visit cost?
answer: A visit to a general practitioner costs 18 crowns.

question: I'm 52 and employed by the weather service at the coastal weather station on the Grauby headland; no public road reaches it, only a boat landing, and I stayed there 140 nights last year. If I buy an annual fishing licence now, in August, how much do I pay?
answer: Because you are buying it after 30 June, the annual fishing licence costs half the annual price, which is 21 crowns.

question: I sell only flowers and pumpkins that I grow on 1.5 hectares in Lund Vale, which the Property Register records as agricultural land, from a table on a street in Aldmark. What does a daily street trading licence cost me?
answer: Because you sell only your own produce from registered farmland of not more than 10 hectares, a daily street trading licence costs you 4 crowns instead of 9 crowns.

question: The district court appointed me as the guardian of my 11-year-old nephew, to care for him and act for him, after his parents died, and he lives with me in Brenholt. He takes the bus from Brenholt to his school. What does a single ticket cost for him?
answer: A child aged 7 to 15 pays half of the single ticket fare; a single ticket in zone B costs 4.50 crowns, so he pays 2.25 crowns.

question: My father is 78 and lives in Fjellmo, in the municipality of Dunmere. He can no longer manage buses or trains. How many trips a week can he get with the municipal transport service, and what does each trip cost?
answer: He is entitled to 3 trips per week with the municipal transport service, at 2 crowns per trip.

question: My wife is 79 and I'm 76; we are the only two people registered at our house in Elsby. If we apply for the relief we are entitled to, what snow clearing fee does our household pay?
answer: As your household lives in a small municipality, you pay the reduced snow clearing fee of 50 crowns a year.

question: What is the fee for sitting a written examination at a public school?
answer: The fee for a written examination is 20 crowns.

question: I'm a registered sole proprietor and run a tailoring business from the house I live in, in Holmstad on the island of Holm, and customers come to me for fittings. What is the annual home business permit fee?
answer: The annual home business permit fee is 55 crowns.

question: I sing in the Aldmark Cathedral Consort, which is on Aldmark's register of ensembles; each singer receives a fee for every concert. I'm booking a meeting room at the Aldmark public library for a 2-hour rehearsal of the consort. How much will the room cost?
answer: Library meeting rooms cost 12 crowns per hour, so 2 hours cost 24 crowns.

question: I'm 34 and registered as living on the island of Varr. Today I'm buying an adult single ticket on the Harbour Authority ferry to the mainland, paying by card. It's only my sixth ferry ticket this year. How much do I actually pay?
answer: An adult single ferry ticket costs 20 crowns, and as a resident of an island municipality you get a 50 percent subsidy on it, so you pay 10 crowns.

question: I'm 29 and an unpaid member of Dunmere's municipal volunteer fire brigade; last year I logged 40 hours of brigade training. What do I pay for a single visit to the municipal gymnasium?
answer: An adult pays 6 crowns for a single visit to a municipal gymnasium.

question: I'm one of five members of the Corvik Folk Orchestra, an unpaid amateur orchestra that is on Corvik's official list of amateur music groups, who will play together for donations in a square in Corvik for a whole week before Christmas, without amplifiers. What does my weekly street music permit cost?
answer: Because you play for donations together with at least three other members of your registered amateur orchestra, you pay half of the 50-crown weekly street music fee, which is 25 crowns.

question: I'm 33, live in Brenholt and have been on the jobseeker list kept by my municipality since 3 November 2025. I want my first library card at the Brenholt library. What is the fee?
answer: A library card is issued for a fee of 8 crowns and is valid for 3 years.

question: I'm a self-employed electrician registered as a sole proprietor, with no employer. I live in Fennick and drive 40 kilometres each way to my workshop in Corvik. Can I get the commuting allowance, and how much is it?
answer: Yes. As you live in a small municipality and travel more than 30 kilometres one way to work, you receive a commuting allowance of 25 crowns per month.

question: I run a food truck selling crepes and I trade only in Fennick, nowhere else. I don't want the annual permit; I only need a monthly food truck permit for July. How much is it?
answer: The monthly food truck permit costs 45 crowns. The reduced fee for small municipalities applies only to the annual permit, so the monthly fee is not reduced.

question: An approved installer has just put 8 kilowatts of solar panels on the roof of the house I own and live in, in Corvik. My yearly income is 32,000 crowns and this is the only energy grant I am claiming this year. How much solar panel grant will the Energy Agency pay?
answer: The grant is 300 crowns per kilowatt, but no more than 6 kilowatts per dwelling are paid, so you receive 1,800 crowns.

question: I belong to the Holm municipal volunteer fire brigade, without pay, and did 28 hours of brigade training in 2025. What does an annual pass for the class 3 mountain trails cost me?
answer: As an active volunteer firefighter you pay 20 crowns for the annual trail pass instead of the usual 55 crowns.

question: I'm 23, live in Aldmark and I'm enrolled for 32 study credits this semester at a recognised university. I registered my e-bike (200 W) on 10 February 2026. What annual registration fee applies to it now?
answer: As a full-time student you pay half of the 30-crown electric bicycle fee, so 15 crowns a year.

question: I'm employed as a data-centre technician and work from 20:00 to 04:00 three times a week, every week of the year. I've just borrowed a cookbook from the public library in Corvik. How long can I keep it?
answer: A borrower may keep a book for 28 days.

question: I'm on the volunteer crew that takes the Dunmere lifeboat to sea on rescues. I own one diesel car, registered in my name. How much is this year's renewal of its registration if I pay before 31 March?
answer: The annual renewal fee for a registered car is 40 crowns.

question: I'm 45 and play the cello in the Dunmere Town Orchestra, an unpaid amateur orchestra that Dunmere has entered on its official list of amateur music groups. Tomorrow I take the train from Aldmark to a concert, carrying the cello in its hard case, which measures 140 by 65 centimetres. What extra fare do I pay for the cello?
answer: Because the case is larger than 100 by 60 centimetres, you must buy an additional single ticket for a journey starting in zone A, which costs 3.50 crowns.

question: I'm learning the electrician's trade on the job under a written apprenticeship contract with an electrical firm. I'd like to take the municipal adult course in accounting (20 lessons) this spring; it would be my first course this year. What is the course fee?
answer: The course fee for a municipal adult course in accounting is 150 crowns for 20 lessons.

question: I farm 14 hectares of my own land near Grauby that the Property Register records as agricultural land. I'm registering my first trailer, which has a maximum weight of 700 kg, to carry my produce. What is the registration fee?
answer: A light trailer of 750 kilograms or less has a one-time registration fee of 25 crowns.

question: In total I've worked 6 years at remote coastal posts, all of it at the lighthouse on a reef off Brenholt (no road to it), and last year I spent 180 nights there. I want to put my 7-metre motor boat into winter storage on land at Brenholt harbour from 1 October to 30 April. What's the storage fee?
answer: Winter storage on land for a boat up to 8 metres long costs 150 crowns for the period from 1 October to 30 April.

question: I live in Aldmark and I'm taking the bus across Aldmark this afternoon to my plasma donation appointment at the donation centre. I'm 28. How much is a single ticket?
answer: A single ticket for a journey starting in zone A costs 3.50 crowns.

question: I'm taking 24 credits this semester at the university in Corvik and renting a room away from my parents. How much rent support can I get per month?
answer: Students who rent a room away from their parents receive rent support of 150 crowns per month.

question: I'm putting up a new 90 square metre workshop building next to my house in Fjellmo, in the municipality of Dunmere, and need a building permit. What is the fee?
answer: Because Fjellmo is a highland settlement 860 metres above sea level, you pay only the per-square-metre part of the building permit fee: 3 crowns x 90 = 270 crowns.

question: Our twins were born in the hospital in Brenholt on 2 February 2026. What one-off grants do we get for their birth, in total?
answer: You receive the birth grant of 450 crowns for each twin, plus a multiple birth grant of 200 crowns for the second twin, so 1,100 crowns in total.

question: I came to Nordvale from abroad in February 2024 and registered as a resident in Aldmark; I had never lived here before. I have a valid foreign driving licence and passed the practical car test on 3 September 2024. How much is the licence issue fee?
answer: The issue fee for a driving licence is 50 crowns.

question: I moved to Nordvale from abroad and was registered as a resident of Brenholt on 1 February 2025, my first time living here. I hold a valid foreign driving licence and passed the practical car test on 25 November 2025. What is the issue fee for my licence?
answer: Because you hold a valid foreign licence and passed the practical test within 12 months of first registering as a resident, the issue fee is 20 crowns instead of the usual 50 crowns.

question: I'm in the second year of my apprenticeship contract with a plumbing company, and the contract requires me to pass a practical examination at the public vocational school on 20 May. I'm registering for it today. What is the examination fee?
answer: The fee for a practical examination is 45 crowns, due 21 days before the examination.

question: I farm 5 hectares near Brenholt myself; the land is mine and is recorded in the Property Register as agricultural land. I'm starting to sell my raw vegetables and eggs directly to customers, nothing cooked or processed, and I'm registering this as a food business. What is the registration fee?
answer: The registration fee for a food business is 50 crowns, and you must register at least 28 days before you start selling.

question: Our household is registered at an address in the town of Dunmere itself, not in one of its outlying settlements. What energy rebate do we receive this year?
answer: Your household receives an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns, paid in January.

question: I play the double bass in the Brenholt Philharmonic Society, a volunteer orchestra (none of us is paid) that is officially listed with the municipality of Brenholt as an amateur music group. I take the bus from Brenholt to rehearsals in Corvik with the bass in a case of about 190 by 70 centimetres, and I buy my single ticket in the app. Do I have to pay anything extra for the bass?
answer: Yes. A passenger carrying luggage larger than 100 by 60 centimetres must pay for an additional single ticket in the same zone, so you buy a second single ticket for the bass.

question: I'm 39 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. I've had dialysis three times a week at Dunmere hospital since 2022, as my nephrologist ordered. For my birthday I want to hire the whole municipal sports hall for 2 hours on a Sunday. How much will the hire cost?
answer: No reduction applies to hiring the hall; a municipal sports hall costs 35 crowns per hour, so 2 hours cost 70 crowns.

question: My husband was a pensioner and died last month. For how long will I receive the survivor pension?
answer: As a surviving spouse you receive 60 percent of the basic pension for 18 months after the death.

question: I live in Corvik with my 10-year-old son. I forgot to claim the child clothing allowance for 2024. Can I still claim it now, and how much is it?
answer: Yes, you can claim it: a parent receives a child clothing allowance of 100 crowns for 2024 for each child under 16.

question: I'm a single mum; my two daughters, aged 6 and 9, and I are the only people registered at our house in Grauby, and their father lives abroad and has no contact with them. This afternoon I'm taking both girls to the public swimming pool and we're all going in. What are the girls' admission fees?
answer: A child under 12 pays 5 crowns for admission to a public swimming pool, so the two girls pay 10 crowns together.

question: Our household lives in Brenholt town centre. How much is the yearly energy rebate and when is it paid?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns, paid in January.

question: I sell coffee from a van parked on a square in Brenholt. If I don't want the annual permit, how much is the monthly food truck permit?
answer: You can pay a monthly food truck permit fee of 40 crowns instead of the annual fee.

question: The municipality of Brenholt has classified my dog as dangerous. On top of the normal licence fee, what extra do I have to pay each year?
answer: You pay a dangerous dog surcharge of 150 crowns per year in addition to the licence fee, due on the same day as the licence fee.

question: Our household in Dunmere rents its home and is installing an electric heat pump costing 2,000 crowns. We get no insulation grant. What grant can we get?
answer: You receive a heat pump grant of 25 percent of the cost, which is 500 crowns.

question: I live on Varr and take my car on the ferry to the mainland. What subsidy do I get on the car ticket?
answer: You get a 30 percent subsidy on each car ferry ticket.

question: Our household is registered in Grauby. The fastest fixed internet we can get at our address is 30 megabits per second, so we use mobile data. Is there broadband support, and how much?
answer: Yes. A household whose residence cannot get a fixed connection of at least 100 megabits per second receives broadband support of 10 crowns per month, paid per household.

question: My daughter is 9. How much does she pay to enter the state art gallery?
answer: A child under 12 years of age pays 3 crowns.

question: I'm 44 and have been on Dunmere's register of people looking for work, without a break, since 18 August 2025. What will one adult visit to the public swimming pool cost me? I'll pay by card.
answer: As you have been on the jobseeker register for more than 6 months, you pay half the adult admission fee of 10 crowns, so 5 crowns.

question: I'm 27, a student enrolled for 28 credits, renting a room in Brenholt while my parents live in Aldmark. How much rent support can I get?
answer: As a full-time student renting away from your parents, you receive rent support of 150 crowns per month.

question: My mother is 80 and lives alone in Brattli, in the municipality of Grauby. She can no longer cook, so the municipality delivers a hot meal to her home. What does each delivered meal cost?
answer: Each meal delivered to the home costs 5 crowns.

question: I registered as a sole proprietor four months ago and I'm about to sell knitted scarves from a stall at the weekly municipal market in Dunmere. What does the stall permit cost me per market day?
answer: The market stall permit fee is 12 crowns per market day.

question: I'm 24. My plumbing apprenticeship contract ended in January 2025 when I qualified, and I've been working as an employee since. Now I want to register as a sole proprietor before I take on my own customers. What is the registration fee?
answer: The one-time registration fee for a sole proprietor is 75 crowns.

question: Oops, I've been selling homemade jam at fairs for a while without registering. I'm registering as a sole proprietor today. Is there a penalty on top of the normal fee?
answer: Yes, you pay a late registration surcharge of 50 crowns in addition to the registration fee.

question: I sing in the Aldmark Oratorio Society, an amateur choir on Aldmark's municipal register of ensembles; nobody in it is paid. We are giving an open-air concert in a park in Aldmark on a Sunday from 15:00 to 17:00; only our own members will perform, and the sound may reach 65 decibels at nearby homes. I'm applying for the noise permit. What does the daytime noise permit cost?
answer: A permit for an event with noise of up to 70 decibels between 07:00 and 22:00 costs 40 crowns.

question: I'm 27 and have been on my municipality's jobseeker register without a break since 13 January 2025. I'm booking the practical driving test for a car (category C). What is the fee?
answer: The fee for the practical test for category C is 135 crowns, paid when you book the test.

question: I'm 33 and live in Aldmark. Over the past year I've given whole blood four times at the national blood service's donation centre. How much is a visit to my general practitioner?
answer: A visit to a general practitioner costs 15 crowns, paid at the point of care.

question: I grow potatoes and onions myself on 4 hectares in Grauby that I own and that the Property Register lists as land in agricultural use. I've just bought a trailer with a maximum weight of 600 kg to haul my harvest, and it's the only trailer I have. What is the registration fee?
answer: A trailer with a maximum weight of 750 kilograms or less has a one-time registration fee of 25 crowns.

question: I hold a veteran's card and live in Grauby with one cat. What is the yearly cat registration fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for one cat is 20 crowns.

question: I've been on the municipal register of people looking for work since 12 January 2026, and my monthly income is 2,600 crowns. My 8-year-old daughter, my only child in municipal childcare, will attend the municipal holiday club for one week of 5 days, 10 to 14 August 2026. What is the holiday club fee for that week?
answer: The holiday club costs 15 crowns per day, so 75 crowns for the 5-day week, paid in advance.

question: I'm 52, live in Brenholt and registered my e-bike (200 W) on 20 June 2026 for personal use. What yearly fee applies to it at the moment?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 30 crowns.

question: I'm 28, live in Brenholt, and I'm registering my brand-new e-bike (200 W motor) today, 1 July 2026. What is the yearly fee?
answer: From 1 July 2026 the electric bicycle registration fee is 30 crowns a year, so that is what you pay.

question: I'm a sole proprietor in Dunmere. I filed my annual statement on 10 June 2026 instead of by 31 March. What late filing surcharge do I owe?
answer: Your statement is late into a third started month (April, May and June), so the surcharge is 3 times 15 crowns, which is 45 crowns.

question: I moved to Nordvale from abroad and was registered as a resident of Corvik on 10 June 2025, the first time I have lived here. I hold a valid driving licence from my home country, and yesterday I passed the practical car test. What is the issue fee for my Nordvale licence?
answer: After passing the practical test you pay an issue fee of 50 crowns, and your first licence is valid for 10 years.

question: I live in Fennick and worked 100 full days from home this year as an employee. How much home office allowance do I get?
answer: You receive 2 crowns per day worked from home, so 200 crowns.

question: hey so i adopted a cat, she's about 2 yrs old, we live in corvik. also got a goldfish lol but i assume fish are free. how much is the yearly cat registration?
answer: Your cat's annual registration fee is 20 crowns.

question: I've been a licensed harbour pilot for 12 years without a break and still am; in 2025 I guided 104 ships in or out of Brenholt harbour. At 14:00 today I'm taking a taxi alone for 8 km, no waiting, paying by card. What's the most the driver can charge?
answer: The driver may charge at most a 6-crown starting fee plus 2.80 crowns per kilometre, so 6 + 22.40 = 28.40 crowns.

question: My wife is 80 and I'm 70, we live together in Elsby. Someone told me old people pay nothing for snow clearing. What do we pay?
answer: Your household pays a reduced snow clearing fee of 50 crowns a year, granted on application, because you live in a small municipality.

question: I'm 41 and live in Elsby. How much does a library card from the Elsby public library cost me?
answer: A library card is issued for a fee of 8 crowns and is valid for 3 years.

question: I hold a teaching certificate, but I work as an accountant and in the evenings I teach Spanish courses for adults run by the municipality of Corvik; I don't teach at any school. I'm 52. What is the admission fee for me at the state art gallery?
answer: The adult admission fee for the state art gallery is 10 crowns.

question: I'm 21, live in Aldmark and I'm a full-time university student enrolled for 30 study credits this semester. I'm registering an e-bike with a 200 W motor. What do I pay?
answer: As a full-time student you pay half of the electric bicycle fee of 24 crowns, which is 12 crowns.

question: I want to organise a one-day indoor music festival with 500 visitors in a public place. What is the permit fee?
answer: The permit fee for an event with 201 to 1,000 visitors is 90 crowns.

question: I'm 39 and I've never had a driving licence. I live in the town centre of Dunmere and I've been an unpaid Scout leader there for 6 years without a break, in a group registered as an association since 1985.
