I'm getting a learner permit so my sister can take me out practising. I'll pay by card. How much is it?
answer: A learner permit costs 25 crowns.

question: From what time do quiet hours start in my neighbourhood from today?
answer: As of today, quiet hours run from 23:00 to 07:00 every day.

question: I'm a full-time student (35 credits) in Brenholt and have one dog aged 3. How much is the dog licence?
answer: The annual licence fee is 40 crowns per dog.

question: I'm 24, signed up with the Army Reserve two years ago and completed 16 days of reserve training in 2025. I'm booking the theory test for my car licence. How much is it?
answer: The theory test fee is 50 crowns, paid when you book the test, and the result is valid for 12 months.

question: I'm organising a one-day neighbourhood street party in Grauby for about 150 people. What does the event permit cost?
answer: For a public event with up to 200 participants the permit fee is 50 crowns per event day, so you pay 50 crowns.

question: My son is in his third year at the public primary school in Fennick. I'm bringing him up by myself: nobody else is registered at our address, and his father has no contact with us. What tuition fee per term can the school authority charge for him?
answer: The school authority may charge a tuition fee of 130 crowns per term for him.

question: I live in Brenholt town centre. How many bulky waste collections can I order free of charge in a calendar year?
answer: You may order a collection of bulky waste four times in each calendar year free of charge.

question: I'm 45 and live in Kolbu, in the municipality of Dunmere. Last night an ambulance took me 25 km from my home to the hospital in Dunmere; I was not in danger of death. It's the first health care fee I've had this year. What do I pay for the ambulance?
answer: The fee for transport by ambulance is 60 crowns per journey.

question: My 14-year-old grandson has lived with me since the district court appointed me to care for him two years ago; his parents are both alive. He is in his second year at a public lower secondary school. What term fee can the school authority charge for him?
answer: The tuition fee at a public lower secondary school is 165 crowns per term.

question: Ordinary pedal bike, no motor. I'm 40 and I'm registered at my flat in Holmstad. Do I need to pay anything to register it each year?
answer: Yes, the annual registration fee for a bicycle without a motor is 10 crowns, due on 1 January.

question: I'm 63 and live in the town centre of Corvik. I've been on dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) at Corvik hospital three times a week since 2022, as my kidney doctor ordered. I'd like to drop in to the municipal sports hall once to practise badminton with friends. What will my own entry cost?
answer: There is no reduction for your situation; the adult admission fee for a municipal sports hall is 5 crowns.

question: I let a flat I own in Brenholt (I don't live there) to tourists for stays of 2 to 5 nights. In the first quarter of 2026 it was already rented for 26 nights. In the second quarter guests paid me 4,000 crowns for the nights plus 400 crowns in cleaning charges. How much rental duty do I owe for the second quarter?
answer: The duty is 5 percent of the rent, so you owe 200 crowns on the 4,000 crowns of rent for the second quarter.

question: I sing in the Fennick Village Choir, which is on Fennick's register of amateur ensembles; we are 25 singers and nobody is paid. I want to rent the municipal sports hall in Fennick for a 3-hour rehearsal of the choir on a Saturday. What does it cost?
answer: A municipal sports hall costs 35 crowns per hour, so a 3-hour booking costs 105 crowns.

question: I'm 19 and live in Corvik town centre. Since September 2025 I've been training to become an electrician at a firm in Brenholt under a three-year contract that is entered in the municipal apprenticeship register. What does my monthly bus and train pass cost?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone B costs 80 crowns.

question: I'm 20 and a full-time student at the university in Aldmark with 30 study credits this semester. I registered my e-bike (200 W motor) in November 2024. What will I pay when I renew its registration on 1 January 2025?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 24 crowns, due on each renewal on 1 January.

question: Our household is registered on the island of Varr: me, my husband and our 10-year-old daughter. Our total income last year was 14,000 crowns. How much housing allowance plus child supplement do we get for the year?
answer: You receive the housing allowance of 260 crowns plus a child supplement of 30 crowns for your daughter, 290 crowns in total.

question: I sell only eggs and vegetables from my own 2-hectare farm near Fennick, which is recorded in the Property Register as agricultural land, from a folding table on a street in Corvik. What does one daily street trading licence cost me?
answer: A daily street trading licence costs 9 crowns per day.

question: I'm 38 and work as an employed shelf stacker for a supermarket chain in Aldmark. My employment contract has my shifts finishing at 02:00, on about 18 days each month. I want a monthly pass for journeys starting in Aldmark. What does it cost?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone A costs 60 crowns.

question: I'm 35, live in Corvik, and just bought a bike with a 300 W electric motor. Yearly registration?
answer: As the owner of an electric bicycle you pay an annual registration fee of 24 crowns.

question: Our household lives in Skarholt, in the municipality of Grauby. In total, what will our household receive this January?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 300 crowns, paid in January.

question: My son is 3 and attends a municipal kindergarten for 30 hours a week. What is the monthly kindergarten fee?
answer: The monthly kindergarten fee for a child aged 3 to 5 is 145 crowns.

question: I hold a veteran's card and live in Brenholt with one dog, 3 years old. What dog licence fee do I pay?
answer: The annual dog licence fee is 45 crowns.

question: I got my veteran's card in March 2019 and have never renewed it. I live in Brenholt with one adult dog. Do I still have to pay the dog licence fee?
answer: No. A holder of a veteran's card pays no licence fee for one dog.

question: The district court appointed me to raise my late cousin's 8-year-old son and to act for him; he lives with me in Dunmere and goes to the municipal after-school club. What is the monthly fee for the club?
answer: The monthly fee for a municipal after-school club is 60 crowns.

question: I'm 33, live in Corvik and registered my e-bike (200 W motor) in March 2026 for my own use. The fee went up in July. Which yearly fee applies to me now?
answer: Because your e-bike was registered before 1 July 2026, the old fee of 24 crowns keeps applying until your first renewal on or after 1 January 2027.

question: Two years ago I retired from my job as a records officer at the Dunmere municipal office after 20 years there, and I now receive the basic pension. How much is an adult ticket to the national museum for me?
answer: An adult ticket to the national museum costs 14 crowns and is valid for one visit on the day you buy it.

question: I'm 68 and rent a flat in Elsby. Elsby is a small municipality, so is my pensioner rent support increased by the 20 percent small-municipality supplement? How much do I get per month?
answer: No. The pensioner rent support is paid per person, and the 20 percent supplement only applies to allowances paid per household, so you receive 55 crowns per month.

question: I live in Skarholt, in the municipality of Grauby. This year I've already had three free collections of old furniture, in July, August and early September, and now I want a fourth collection for a sofa and a bed frame. What does it cost?
answer: Each further bulky waste collection in the same calendar year costs 45 crowns.

question: My partner and I are both registered at the same flat in Corvik. Are we one household?
answer: Yes, a household means the persons registered at the same residential address. Persons registered at different addresses also count as one household if they share living costs.

question: I'm organising a one-evening open-air concert in a public park in Corvik for 450 ticketed visitors. What cultural event permit fee do I pay, and how early must I apply?
answer: For an open-air concert with more than 200 visitors the open-air concert permit applies instead of the medium event permit: the fee is 160 crowns, and you must apply at least 45 days before the concert.

question: I own a petrol car registered in my name and live in Brenholt. I'm a volunteer who goes to sea with the Brenholt lifeboat's crew. My yearly car registration renewal is due on 31 March. How much is it?
answer: The yearly renewal fee for a registered car is 40 crowns, due on 31 March.

question: I want a day fishing licence for tomorrow. How much does it cost? Today is 3 February 2026.
answer: The day fishing licence costs 7 crowns.

question: I'm 52 and live on the island of Kessa. I'm registering a bicycle fitted with a 500 W electric motor for my own use. What is the annual registration fee?
answer: As a 500 W bicycle is not an electric bicycle, it pays the motorised bicycle registration fee of 60 crowns a year.

question: I'm 24, a part-time student enrolled for 20 credits, living in Corvik. I'm registering an electric bicycle with a 250 W motor for personal use. What is the fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 24 crowns.

question: Our association runs a licensed lottery. What is the most we can charge for one ticket?
answer: A single lottery ticket may cost at most 20 crowns. Tickets sold online may cost up to 25 crowns.

question: I've been on the municipal register of people seeking work since 20 May 2026, and my monthly income is 2,600 crowns. Today I'm putting my 2-year-old son on the waiting list for a municipal nursery place. Is there a fee for the waiting list?
answer: Yes, registering a child on the waiting list costs a one-off fee of 12 crowns.

question: My husband died in 2023, and since then my 3-year-old daughter and I are the only people registered at our flat in Brenholt. She is my only child and goes to the municipal kindergarten. What is the monthly fee?
answer: The monthly fee for a child aged 3 to 5 in a municipal kindergarten is 140 crowns.

question: I live in Corvik town centre. I worked 16 years at the Corvik municipal social office and now draw the basic pension. How much is my monthly pass for bus and train trips starting in Corvik?
answer: Because you receive the basic pension after more than 15 years of municipal work, you pay 10 crowns less than the normal 75 crowns, so the monthly pass costs you 65 crowns.

question: I received a decision after an event on 7 March 2026 and have 14 days to respond. When is my last day?
answer: Counting from the day after the event, the 14 days would end on Saturday 21 March, but because that is not a working day the period runs to Monday 23 March 2026.

question: My bicycle has a motor with 300 W continuous rated power. Is it an electric bicycle under the law?
answer: No. An electric bicycle is one whose motor does not exceed 250 watts, so your 300 W bicycle is not an electric bicycle.

question: I want to organise an open-air concert in a public park for 150 visitors, who will each buy a ticket. What is the fee for the event permit?
answer: The permit fee for an event with up to 200 visitors is 35 crowns.

question: I am driving my car on a motorway in Nordvale. What is the speed limit?
answer: The speed limit on a motorway is 120 kilometres per hour, unless a road sign shows a lower limit.

question: I moved to Nordvale from abroad and registered as a resident of Dunmere on 15 May 2025, my first time living here. I hold a valid foreign driving licence and passed the practical car test on 24 August 2026. What is the issue fee for my Nordvale licence?
answer: The issue fee for a driving licence is 50 crowns.

question: I hold a valid veteran's card and keep 9 dogs for breeding at my kennel in Grauby. What do I pay for the kennel licence this year? Does my veteran's card make one dog free?
answer: You pay the annual kennel licence fee of 400 crowns. The veteran's dog licence relief does not apply to a kennel licence.

question: I joined Corvik's municipal volunteer fire brigade in 2022 and I'm not paid for it, but because of a knee injury my training record for 2025 shows only 18 hours of drills. What does a single adult visit to the municipal gymnasium cost?
answer: An adult pays 6 crowns for a single visit to a municipal gymnasium.

question: I'm 44 and employed as one of the two keepers of the lighthouse on a rock about 6 km off Corvik. No road goes out there, so I commute by boat, and I slept at the light 190 nights last year. I've just bought a motor boat with a 30 kW engine for those trips. What do I pay to register it with the Harbour Authority?
answer: A motor boat with an engine of more than 10 kilowatts must be registered with the Harbour Authority, and the one-time registration fee is 75 crowns.

question: I'm 68 and collect my basic pension. I left the licensing department of the Ministry of Transport when I retired in 2022, after 18 years there. What do I pay to get into the national museum as an adult?
answer: Adult admission to the national museum is 12 crowns.

question: Our household is registered on Kessa. What energy rebate will we receive?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns, paid in January.

question: I've been registered as a sole proprietor for three years and sell cheese, cold and packaged, from a stall at the Corvik municipal market. What is the daily stall fee?
answer: The market stall permit fee is 12 crowns per market day.

question: My daughter starts her first school year this August. We live in Brenholt. Is there a school start allowance, and how much is it?
answer: Yes. A parent receives a school start allowance of 60 crowns for each child who starts the first school year, paid once per child in August.

question: I run a one-person pottery business in Holmstad and ship my goods to the mainland by ferry freight. What subsidy can I get on the freight charges?
answer: You can get a subsidy of 25 percent of your ferry freight charges, on charges of up to 12,000 crowns per calendar year.

question: I have a street trading licence for a pitch in Brenholt and the municipality has not set shorter hours. From today, what hours can I trade?
answer: You may trade from 6 in the morning until 8 in the evening, and you then have half an hour to clear your pitch.

question: I am 80 years old and I spend one day at a municipal day centre. What fee do I pay for the day?
answer: You pay a fee of 9 crowns for each day at a municipal day centre.

question: I'm 77 and live in the town centre of Grauby. I was on the referee list of the Nordvale Football Federation, which runs football across Nordvale, from 1975 to 2010, and in each of those years I refereed at least 20 league matches as the main referee. I came off the list when I retired and I'm not on any referee list now. I go to the day centre run by Grauby municipality two days a week. What does each day cost me?
answer: Each day at the municipal day centre costs 9 crowns, which includes a meal and transport within the municipality.

question: I'm 20, a full-time student enrolled for 30 credits, living in Brenholt. I'm registering an electric bicycle with a 250 W motor for personal use. What is the fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 24 crowns.

question: I hold a teaching certificate and teach biology at the vocational school in Brenholt. This month I want to print 30 colour pages of worksheets for my lessons at the Brenholt public library; I haven't printed anything there yet this month. What will it cost?
answer: Colour printing in a public library costs 2 crowns per page, so 30 colour pages cost 60 crowns.

question: I'm a widower raising my 3-year-old son alone in Aldmark; we are the only two people registered at our address. The February kindergarten fee was due on 5 February and I paid it on 28 February. Do I owe a late charge?
answer: Yes. A fee that is not paid within 14 days of the due date bears a late charge of 5 crowns.

question: I got my first driving licence, category C, 14 months ago. I now have 7 penalty points, all from the last year. Will my licence be suspended?
answer: No. A licence is suspended only when the holder collects 12 penalty points within 24 months.

question: I'm 44 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. My kidneys failed last year, and since May 2025 I've done my own dialysis at home every night through a tube in my belly, as my nephrologist arranged. I'd like one swim at the public pool this week. What does it cost?
answer: No reduction applies to you; you pay the full adult admission fee of 10 crowns for a public swimming pool.

question: I plan to build a new 60 square metre cabin on my plot in Corvik. Do I need a building permit?
answer: Yes, a new building with a floor area of more than 50 square metres needs a building permit before work starts.

question: I live in Aldmark. How much does a permit for a noisy night event of up to 60 decibels cost?
answer: A permit for an event with noise of up to 60 decibels during quiet hours costs 120 crowns.

question: I rent out my flat in Brenholt for weekend stays of 2 or 3 nights, and I've already rented it out for more than 20 nights this year. What duty do I pay on the rent?
answer: The duty on short-term rentals is 5 percent of the rent, and it is paid quarterly.

question: I teach a class of 9-year-olds at the primary school in Grauby, and on Wednesday I'm taking them to the public swimming pool for their weekly swimming lesson. What do I pay for my own admission?
answer: Nothing: a teacher who accompanies a school class to a public swimming pool for a swimming lesson pays no admission for that visit.

question: Our household is registered in Fennick. We had the roof of the house we live in insulated and the work cost 4,000 crowns. How much home insulation grant do we get under the Household Allowances Act?
answer: Your household gets 1,440 crowns: 40 percent of 4,000 crowns is 1,600, which is capped at 1,200 crowns, and the 20 percent small-municipality increase is then added on top of the capped amount.

question: I'm 47, live in Brenholt and have been on the sea-going volunteer crew of the Brenholt lifeboat for 9 years. How much does an annual museum card cost?
answer: An annual museum card costs 65 crowns and gives free entry to the permanent exhibitions of every state museum for 365 days.

question: I'm 40, registered at my flat in Brenholt, but I spend most weekends at our summer cabin on Kessa where I keep an ordinary pedal bike. What's the yearly registration fee for that bike?
answer: The annual registration fee for a bicycle without a motor is 10 crowns.

question: Our household lives in Elsby and our address cannot get a fixed internet connection of 100 megabits per second, so we use a mobile data subscription. How much broadband support do we get?
answer: Your household receives broadband support of 10 crowns per month towards the mobile data subscription.

question: I live on Kessa but rent out a flat I own in Corvik for short stays. I've already rented it out for more than 20 nights this year. What is the duty rate on the rent?
answer: The duty is 5 percent of the rent, paid quarterly.

question: I'm 39 and a keeper employed at a lighthouse off Dunmere that you can only reach by boat; I slept there 210 nights last year. I'm ashore this week and seeing my GP at the Dunmere health centre on Thursday. What's the visit fee?
answer: A visit to a general practitioner costs 18 crowns, paid at the point of care.

question: I'm 26, live in Corvik and registered my e-bike with a 340 W motor on 20 August 2026. I use it for commuting. What annual registration fee do I pay?
answer: Since 1 January 2026 a bicycle whose motor does not exceed 350 watts counts as an electric bicycle, so you pay the annual fee of 30 crowns.

question: I have my teaching certificate and teach English full-time at a lower secondary school in Aldmark, where I also live. I'm 41. What does a monthly bus and train pass for journeys starting in Aldmark cost me?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone A costs 60 crowns.

question: I'm 41 and live in Aldmark. I'm a currently licensed harbour pilot, guiding ships in and out of Aldmark harbour; in 2024 I guided 64 ships in or out. I'm buying my February bus and train card in the app. Is there any discount for me?
answer: No reduction applies to you as a pilot; you pay the full price of a zone A monthly pass, 60 crowns.

question: I am 17 years old. Can I receive a category C car licence now?
answer: No. A person must be at least 18 years old to receive a category C licence.

question: I ran an unlicensed lottery draw last month. What is the fine for each draw held?
answer: The fine for running a lottery without a licence is 2,500 crowns for each draw held.

question: I live in Aldmark and just bought an electric scooter for myself. What's the annual registration fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric scooter is 20 crowns.

question: I'm registering for a written examination at a public school. How much is the examination fee?
answer: The fee for a written examination is 20 crowns.

question: My son is in his second year of public lower secondary education in the town centre of Dunmere. I became a shareholder of our housing co-op in January 2023; the co-op is officially registered and our family is registered at our flat, which belongs to the co-op. What do we pay per term?
answer: No reduction applies to you; you pay the full 165 crowns per term for lower secondary.

question: My husband and I are 45 and 47 and our household is registered in Holmstad on the island of Holm. What snow clearing fee do we pay?
answer: As Holm is a small island municipality, your household pays the reduced snow clearing fee of 50 crowns a year.

question: On 1 September 2026 I want to hunt red deer. Is that allowed today?
answer: No. Red deer may be hunted only from 15 September to 31 January, so 1 September is before the season opens.

question: I'm the resident keeper, employed by the lighthouse service, at a lighthouse on a rocky outcrop off Corvik; there's only boat access and the lighthouse is also my home. I spent 250 nights there last year. The pharmacy in Corvik is delivering 2 prescription items to me at the lighthouse. What delivery charge will they add?
answer: Home delivery of medicines costs 6 crowns; your order has only 2 items, and delivery is free only for orders of more than 3 items.

question: I'm 38 and live in the town centre of Corvik. I've been a volunteer leader with the 3rd Corvik Scouts since September 2024, for which I'm not paid, and the group has been registered as an association since 1995. My driving licence runs out next month and I'm renewing it now by card. What do I pay?
answer: Renewing a driving licence costs 35 crowns. There is no discount for your situation, so you pay the full 35 crowns.

question: I'm visiting the municipal museum with my 12-year-old niece, whom the district court placed in my care as her guardian two years ago. What do we pay for the two of us?
answer: You pay the adult fee of 5 crowns and your niece pays 2 crowns as a child under 14, so 7 crowns in total.

question: I live in Corvik. At what time do the nightly quiet hours start?
answer: Quiet hours run from 23:00 to 07:00 every day, so they start at 23:00.

question: I live in Corvik and I'm one of the unpaid volunteers who head out to sea on the Corvik lifeboat whenever it is launched. I'd like to rent an annual berth in the harbour for my 7-metre motor boat. What does the annual berth cost?
answer: An annual berth for a boat up to 8 metres long costs 900 crowns a year.

question: My household is registered in Aldmark. How much is our annual energy rebate?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns, paid in January.

question: I've been a licensed harbour pilot for 6 years and still am, and I guided 84 ships in or out of Corvik harbour in 2025. At 22:30 tonight I'm taking a taxi home alone, 12 km, no waiting, paying by card. What's the most the driver can charge?
answer: Because you are a certified fairway conductor travelling alone, the driver may not add the night surcharge, so the most is the 6-crown starting fee plus 12 x 2.80 = 33.60 crowns, 39.60 crowns in total.

question: How much energy rebate did our household, registered in Elsby, receive this January?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 300 crowns.

question: I'm 66 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. I've been on dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) at Dunmere hospital three times a week, as my nephrologist ordered, continuously since February 2021. I want to buy an annual pass for the municipal gym. What will I pay?
answer: An annual pass for the gym costs 410 crowns.

question: I'm 17 and I've saved up for a 340 W e-bike. Is there an age exemption from the registration fee for me?
answer: No. A bicycle with an electric motor that is not an electric bicycle costs 60 crowns a year, and nobody is exempt by reason of age.

question: I'm 79 and my daughter looks after me at home. I'd like a respite stay in a care home so she can rest. How many days a year can I stay, and what does it cost per day?
answer: You may stay in a care home for up to 21 days in each calendar year, and the fee for a respite stay is 14 crowns per day.

question: I'm a registered sole proprietor and run a watch repair business from the flat I live in, in Dunmere, and customers bring their watches to me. What is my annual home business permit fee?
answer: Dunmere is a small municipality, so the annual home business permit fee is 25 crowns.

question: I'm 64, have lived in Nordvale my whole life, and want to retire exactly 2 years before the pension age. What monthly basic pension would I get? It is paid into my bank account.
answer: Retiring 2 full years early reduces the basic pension of 540 crowns by 6 percent per year, so you would receive 475.20 crowns per month.

question: I receive the basic pension after 18 years as an archivist at the State Archives. My doctor says I need 13 physiotherapy sessions this year. How many of them are charged at the ordinary 12-crown session fee?
answer: Only 10 physiotherapy sessions in a calendar year are covered by the 12-crown fee; the other 3 sessions you pay in full.

question: I'm an unpaid member of the Brenholt municipal volunteer fire brigade and did 35 hours of training in 2025. Last night at 20:30 I drove my own car, without a trailer, on the M1 motorway to answer a fire call-out. I don't have a toll pass. What toll do I owe for that passage?
answer: The toll for a car on the M1 motorway is 7 crowns for each passage.

question: I have a veteran's card and live in Aldmark with one dog, 5 years old. What is my yearly dog licence fee?
answer: The annual dog licence fee is 40 crowns.

question: I'm 51 and live in the town centre of Corvik. Since 2023 I've had dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) three times a week at Corvik hospital, as my doctors ordered. I'm buying a monthly pass for the municipal swimming pool today. What does it cost, and how long is it valid?
answer: As a renal filtration patient you pay the category K2 amount of 22 crowns for the 30-day subscription, and its term is extended by 10 days, so it stays valid for 40 days from your first visit.

question: I'm 45 and live in the town centre of Brenholt. My two children are in the 6th Brenholt Scouts and I sometimes drive kids to weekend activities, but I'm not a leader. My 2018 petrol car is in my name and I'm renewing on time by card. What will it cost?
answer: The yearly renewal of your car's registration costs 40 crowns. You pay the full 40 crowns.

question: I'm 66 and live in the town centre of Corvik. From 2000 to 2016 I was on the referee list of the Nordvale Volleyball Federation, which runs volleyball across Nordvale, and refereed at least 20 league matches as first referee in each of those years; I'm not on any list now. Today I have my second physio session of 2025 for my back at the municipal health centre. What will it cost?
answer: No reduction applies to you; each physiotherapy session costs the full 12 crowns.

question: My car is fully electric with zero exhaust emissions and was first registered in 2023. I'm paying this year's registration renewal by card before 31 March 2026. How much is it?
answer: The car renewal fee of 40 crowns is reduced by 20 percent for a zero-emission car, so you pay 32 crowns.

question: I'm 34 and live in the town centre of Brenholt. Since January 2026 I've gone to Brenholt hospital for dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) three mornings a week, as my kidney doctor ordered. I'd like to buy a yearly pass for the municipal swimming pool. How much will it cost?
answer: No reduction is available to you, so the annual pass costs the full 440 crowns.

question: I'm 40, work as a carpenter and live in Skarholt, up in the municipality of Grauby. I'm not a student. What does a monthly pass for the national buses and trains cost me for journeys from home? I'll buy it in the app.
answer: Journeys from Grauby start in zone C, where a monthly pass costs 95 crowns.

question: I'm a veteran with a veteran's card and I keep two dogs, both over a year old, at home in Grauby. Are both covered by my card?
answer: No. Your veteran's card frees you from the licence fee for one dog only, so you still pay the licence fee for your second dog.

question: Our household in Corvik has an annual income of 26,000 crowns. How much heating support do we get this winter?
answer: Your household receives heating support of 35 crowns per month for the months November to March.

question: I'm 52 and want to join the municipal adult reading and writing course in Corvik, a 30-lesson classroom course. What is the course fee?
answer: The fee for an adult reading and writing course of 30 lessons is 30 crowns.

question: I left the Elsby municipal volunteer fire brigade last year after 12 years of service. What does a single visit to the municipal gymnasium cost me as an adult?
answer: An adult pays 6 crowns for a single visit to a municipal gymnasium.

question: I've been raising my sister's 16-year-old daughter since the district court entrusted her to me in 2022. She is in her third year at a public upper secondary school. How much will her tuition cost for a whole school year?
answer: The upper secondary term fee is 210 crowns and it is charged for 3 terms, so a school year costs 630 crowns.

question: I'm 30, I live in Corvik, and since last autumn I've donated plasma at the blood service four times, most recently in July. How much will my dental check-up next week cost?
answer: A dental check-up costs 25 crowns.

question: I'm a full-time university student enrolled for 30 study credits this semester. I live in Aldmark and keep one dog, aged 1. What dog licence fee do I pay?
answer: As a full-time student you pay half of the 45-crown dog licence fee, which is 22.50 crowns.

question: So, quick one. My e-bike (210 watts, nothing fancy) has been registered in Grauby since January 2024. I'm 61, retired, no deliveries. Which annual fee applies to it at the moment?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is currently 30 crowns.

question: I drive my car over the Corvik Bridge once. What toll do I pay?
answer: The toll for a car on the Corvik Bridge is 5 crowns for each passage.

question: I'm a reservist in the Army Reserve and did 12 days of training in 2024. Last Saturday I drove my car from Brenholt to Aldmark on the M1 for a reserve drill and came back the same evening at about 19:00. I don't have a toll pass or a trailer. How much toll do I owe for the two passages?
answer: The M1 car toll is 6 crowns for each passage in each direction, so you owe 12 crowns.

question: I live in Grauby town centre and work as a currently licensed pilot at Brenholt harbour, steering ships in and out; in 2025 I piloted 58 ships in or out. I want a yearly bus and train card for trips starting in Grauby, paid by card today. What does it cost?
answer: An annual pass costs the price of 10 monthly passes of the same zone, so for zone C it is 10 x 95 = 950 crowns.

question: I live on the island of Kessa and bought an electric scooter. What is the yearly registration fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric scooter is 20 crowns.

question: I live in Fennick and got my library card free from the Fennick municipal library last year, but I've lost it. What does a replacement card cost?
answer: The small-municipality waiver covers only the card itself; a replacement for a lost card is charged under the Library Act at 4 crowns and is valid for the rest of the original period.

question: I have a disability card. How much is my monthly disability payment?
answer: The Disability Board pays you 230 crowns for each month, on the 5th day of the month.

question: I run a small cafe. At what temperature must I keep chilled food?
answer: Chilled food must be stored at 5 degrees Celsius or lower, and the temperature must be recorded at least once a day.

question: I live in Fennick and expect to work 150 full days from home this year for my employer. How much home office allowance is that?
answer: You get 2 crowns for each full day worked from home, so 150 days give you 300 crowns.

question: I'm 69, live in Grauby and receive the basic pension after 31 years as a road inspector employed by the state. My driving licence expires in six weeks. How much is the renewal fee?
answer: Renewing a driving licence costs 30 crowns, and you can renew it at the earliest 90 days before it expires.

question: I'm 22 and own a car that I drive across the Corvik Bridge to work. I'm in the second year of a three-year apprenticeship with a car body shop, and my contract is entered in the municipality's apprenticeship register. How much is a monthly toll pass for my car?
answer: A monthly pass for a car costs 75 crowns and allows unlimited passages for one calendar month.

question: Since my partner died two years ago, I've been the only adult registered at our home in Lund Vale with our 12-year-old son. He'll attend the municipal summer camp for 3 weeks this summer. What do I pay in total?
answer: As a lone parent you pay only 65 crowns per week for the summer camp, so 3 weeks cost 195 crowns.

question: Our choir, the Dunmere Madrigal Group, is on Dunmere's register of amateur ensembles and none of us is paid. We're organising a ticketed indoor concert for 120 visitors in a public hall in Dunmere on 14 June 2025, and we're advertising it as part of the week of amateur music. What event permit fee do we pay, and how early must we apply?
answer: For a cultural event with up to 200 visitors you need a small event permit, which costs 30 crowns, and you must apply at least 14 days before the concert.

question: I'm 42 and live in the town centre of Grauby. I'm employed and paid a salary by our regional Scout association as a development officer, and as part of that job I've led a troop in Grauby since 2019. My driving licence is due for renewal and I'll pay by card. What does it cost?
answer: Renewing a driving licence costs 35 crowns. No reduction applies, so you pay the full 35 crowns.

question: I'm 20 and in the first year of a roofing apprenticeship; my contract with the roofing firm is entered in the municipal apprenticeship register. I want to book the driving theory test today. What is the fee?
answer: The theory test fee is 50 crowns, paid when you book the test.

question: I moved to Nordvale from abroad and registered as a resident of Brenholt in September 2025; I had never lived in Nordvale before. I want to join the municipality's adult course in a foreign language, 24 lessons in a classroom. It is my first course this year. What is the course fee?
answer: The fee for a municipal adult language course of 24 lessons is 130 crowns.

question: I sell fish soup from a food truck in Holmstad on the island of Holm. How much is the annual food truck permit?
answer: Because Holm is a small municipality, the annual food truck permit fee is 150 crowns.

question: Our son is 18 months old and has been at the municipal nursery in the town centre of Brenholt for 35 hours a week since last August. I've been a shareholder of our housing co-op continuously since 2017, the co-op is officially registered, and our family is registered at our co-op flat. I live with my wife. What do we pay each month?
answer: There is no discount for you; the full-time nursery fee is 190 crowns a month.

question: I own a holiday flat on the island of Kessa and live in Corvik. In April to June 2026 I rented the flat for 12 nights in total, in stays of 3 or 4 nights, and received 1,800 crowns. These are my only rentals this year. How much rental duty do I owe for the second quarter?
answer: The duty on short-term rentals of a dwelling in an island municipality is 2 percent of the rent, so you owe 36 crowns.

question: I got my veteran's card last year after 14 months of national service. How much is the yearly veterans' allowance?
answer: As a card holder you receive an annual allowance of 560 crowns, paid in March.

question: I'm a sole proprietor and I'm renting a 120 square metre workshop in Brenholt where customers come in. What is the annual commercial premises permit fee?
answer: The annual commercial premises permit fee is 150 crowns.

question: I'm 36, I live in the town centre of Dunmere and I'm a rugby referee on the list of the Nordvale Rugby Union, which runs rugby across Nordvale. In 2023 I refereed 16 league matches as the referee. The union has appointed me to referee a knockout cup tie abroad on 12 December in the club cup of the International Rugby Council, to which the national rugby unions belong, and today I'm getting the two travel jabs I need for it at the municipal health centre. What do I pay?
answer: A travel vaccination costs 10 crowns per dose, so the two doses cost 20 crowns.

question: I'm 47 and live in the town centre of Grauby. I've been an unpaid Scout leader in Grauby, without a break, since 2018, and the group has been registered as an association since 1990. I own one car, a 2016 petrol model in my name, and I'm renewing its registration by card before the deadline. What's the cost?
answer: The yearly car registration renewal is 40 crowns, and nothing reduces it for you, so you pay the full 40 crowns.

question: I came to Nordvale from abroad for the first time in August 2023 and have been registered as a resident of Dunmere since then. I'd like to sign up for my first municipal adult course in a foreign language this year (24 lessons, classroom). How much does it cost?
answer: A municipal adult course in a foreign language costs 120 crowns for 24 lessons.

question: I hold a valid veteran's card and I'm also a full-time university student with 32 study credits this semester. I live in Brenholt and keep two dogs, both over a year old. What do I pay in dog licence fees this year? I pay by card.
answer: Your veteran's card makes one dog free, so you pay only the fee for the second dog, which is 30 crowns.

question: I'm 74 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. From 2000 to 2017 I was on the referee list of the Nordvale Handball Federation, which runs handball across Nordvale, and I refereed at least 25 league matches in each of those years. I'm not on any list any more. I go to the day centre run by Dunmere municipality three days a week. Is there any reduction for a retired referee like me?
answer: No reduction applies to you; you pay the full 9 crowns per day, which is 27 crowns a week.

question: My wife and I are foster parents, and a 6-year-old foster child lives with us in Corvik. How much child benefit per month do we get for her?
answer: The child benefit is 60 crowns per month for each child.

question: I'm 21, living in Aldmark, and studying with 29 credits this semester. My e-bike's motor is 200 W. What's the annual registration fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 24 crowns.

question: I'm a currently licensed harbour pilot in Corvik, guiding ships in and out of the harbour; in 2025 I guided 66 ships in or out. Yesterday I lost my February bus and train card for trips from Corvik. What do I have to pay for a replacement for the rest of February?
answer: No exemption applies to you; a replacement pass for the same month costs 12 crowns.

question: My two children both use municipal childcare: one is 1 year old in a full-time nursery place costing 190 crowns a month, the other is 3 years old in kindergarten. What is our total monthly fee, not counting meals?
answer: The kindergarten fee of 140 crowns is the lower fee, so it is reduced by 25 percent to 105 crowns; with the 190-crown nursery fee you pay 295 crowns a month.

question: I'm 33 and a member of the Army Reserve, where I did 18 days of reserve training last year. I only sorted out my exam today: I'm registering now for a written examination at the vocational school on 8 May 2026. What do I have to pay?
answer: You pay 20 crowns for the written examination plus a late registration fee of 12 crowns, because you are registering less than 7 days before the exam: 32 crowns in total.

question: I'm 21 and a full-time student at the university in Brenholt with 33 study credits this semester. I keep one dog, 3 years old, and in August 2026 I bought and registered an e-bike with a 200 W motor for getting around. I pay by card. What do the dog licence and the e-bike registration cost me together per year?
answer: The e-bike costs 30 crowns a year and the dog licence 45 crowns, so 75 crowns together.

question: I'm in the Elsby municipal volunteer fire brigade, unpaid, and I did 45 hours of brigade drills in 2024. I'd like an annual pass for the class 3 mountain trails. How much is it?
answer: An annual trail pass costs 55 crowns and is valid for all class 3 trails for 12 months.

question: My family lives on Varr and we use a cargo bike without a motor to take the kids around. How much is its yearly registration fee?
answer: A cargo bicycle without a motor costs 20 crowns a year to register.

question: My son is in his second year at the public primary school in the town centre of Grauby. I became a shareholder of our housing co-op in May 2023; the co-op is officially registered, and we're registered at our flat, which belongs to the co-op. Grauby isn't a big town, so is the school fee waived for us, or what do we pay per term?
answer: As a co-op member you pay 85 crowns per term for your son's primary schooling instead of the ordinary 130 crowns.

question: I'm 67 and live in Corvik. I spent 22 years as a clerk in the Corvik municipal planning office until I retired, and I now get the basic pension. I'd like a library card at the Corvik public library. What does it cost?
answer: A library card costs 8 crowns and is valid for 3 years.

question: I play viola in the Holmstad String Orchestra, an amateur orchestra registered with the municipality of Holm; none of us is paid to play. I'd like to book a meeting room at the public library in Holmstad for a 5-hour rehearsal of the orchestra. What will I pay?
answer: Because you are booking the room for a rehearsal of a registered amateur ensemble you belong to, it costs 8 crowns per hour instead of the ordinary library rate, so 5 hours cost 40 crowns.

question: I'm 21 and in the second year of a carpentry apprenticeship; my contract with a joinery firm is entered in the municipal apprenticeship register. I'm booking my practical driving test for a car. What is the fee?
answer: The practical test for category C costs 135 crowns, paid when you book the test.

question: I'm 36 and live in the town centre of Corvik. I've led a Scout troop in Corvik as an unpaid volunteer since 2023, and our group has been registered as an association since 2001. In June I'm sailing my 7-metre sailing boat to Corvik harbour and staying 3 nights; these are my first nights in any harbour this year. I'll pay by card. What will the overnight mooring cost?
answer: Berths for a boat up to 8 metres cost 14 crowns per night, so 3 nights cost 42 crowns.

question: I'm 52, I've passed the hunter's examination, and I only want to shoot foxes and crows on the 9 hectares in Grauby that I own and farm myself; the Property Register records them as agricultural land. What does the annual hunting licence cost?
answer: The annual hunting licence costs 80 crowns and is valid from 1 July to 30 June.

question: I'm 38 and enrolling in a municipal adult Spanish course of 24 lessons in a classroom in the town centre of Grauby, starting on 21 October 2024; it is my first adult course this year. I've been a shareholder of our housing co-op since August 2021, the co-op is officially registered, and I'm registered at my co-op flat. How much is the course?
answer: The Spanish course costs 120 crowns for 24 lessons.

question: Our household in Corvik wants the municipality to collect an old chest freezer, an electric cooker, a television, a desktop computer and a printer, all in one collection. What will that cost?
answer: The collection costs 60 crowns: 40 crowns covers the first 3 items and each of the 2 further items costs 10 crowns.

question: I farm 4 hectares of my own land in Elsby that the Property Register records as agricultural land, and I'm building a new house on it to live in. Connecting the house to the public water network needs a 10-metre pipe from the main. What is the connection fee?
answer: A new connection of a dwelling to the public water network costs a one-time fee of 450 crowns, which covers a pipe of up to 15 metres.

question: My 12-year-old niece has lived with me in Lund Vale since the district court appointed me to care for her and act for her in 2023. She will attend the municipal summer camp for 4 weeks this summer. What is the total cost?
answer: Because she is the ward of a court-appointed guardian who is not her parent, she pays 45 crowns a week instead of 95, so 4 weeks cost 180 crowns.

question: Since last autumn I've been learning masonry under an apprenticeship contract with a building firm in Elsby. What does a monthly pass for the municipal gymnasium cost me?
answer: A monthly pass for a swimming pool or a gymnasium costs 52 crowns.

question: I'm 44, live in Aldmark and have had my e-bike (200 W) registered since 2025. I heard the fee changed on 1 July. What annual fee applies to my e-bike now?
answer: Since 1 July 2026 the electric bicycle registration fee is 30 crowns a year, so that now applies to you.

question: I'm taking the hunter's examination for the first time. How much does the exam cost?
answer: The examination fee is 65 crowns.

question: I'm a registered sole proprietor running a small web design business, and I'm an Army Reserve member who did 25 days of reserve training in 2025. My turnover in 2025 was 34,000 crowns. I filed my annual statement on 22 April 2026. What do I pay?
answer: The annual filing fee is 50 crowns, and because you filed after 31 March you also owe a late filing surcharge of 15 crowns for one started month of delay, 65 crowns in total.

question: I'm 67 and live in Corvik. I want to buy an annual fishing licence for this year now, in March. What does it cost me?
answer: As a person aged 65 or over, you pay 20 crowns for the annual fishing licence.

question: I'm 19 and just started university in Aldmark this September, enrolled for 30 study credits. I have a part-time job that pays me 1,200 crowns a month. Am I entitled to the study grant, and how much is it?
answer: Yes. As a full-time student aged at least 18 and under 29 you are entitled to the study grant, and your wage of 1,200 crowns a month is not above the 1,500-crown limit. The grant is 460 crowns per month.

question: I'm 33, live in Brenholt and run a courier business. I registered my e-bike (250 W) on 2 February 2026 and use it only to deliver meals to paying customers for my business. Now that bicycle fees changed on 1 July 2026, what annual fee applies to it?
answer: Your bike is a delivery bicycle, which now costs 70 crowns a year; the transitional rule for e-bikes registered before 1 July 2026 does not apply to delivery bicycles.

question: I'm a certified teacher and I teach 14 hours a week at the primary school in Dunmere. What will I pay for admission to the state art gallery next week?
answer: Adult admission to the state art gallery costs 11 crowns.

question: My 13-year-old granddaughter has lived with me since the district court appointed me to look after her in 2023; her father is alive but cannot care for her. She is in her second year at a public lower secondary school. What does her schooling cost per school year?
answer: Since a court has entrusted her care to you and you are not her parent, the term fee is 60 crowns instead of 150, and with 3 terms the school year costs 180 crowns.

question: My flat in Holmstad is where our household is registered. What's the annual energy rebate for us?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns.

question: I registered as a sole proprietor in March this year and now sell my ceramics from a stall at the Brenholt municipal market on single days. What do I pay per market day?
answer: You pay a market stall permit fee of 12 crowns for each market day.

question: Need a paper copy of a 30-page zoning report from the Grauby town hall. What will it cost me?
answer: The first 10 pages are free and the other 20 pages cost 1 crown each, so you pay 20 crowns.

question: I'm building a new house with 120 square metres of floor area on my plot in Brattli, which is in the municipality of Grauby. What is the building permit fee?
answer: The building permit fee is 140 crowns plus 3 crowns for each square metre, so 500 crowns for 120 square metres.

question: I've been a sole proprietor for about 18 months now and sell honey from a stall at the Aldmark municipal market. What does a day at the market cost me in permit fees?
answer: The market stall permit fee is 12 crowns per market day.

question: I'm 52 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. For the past two years I've gone to the dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) unit at Dunmere hospital three times a week, as my kidney doctor ordered. On Saturday I want to see the natural history museum. What will it cost me to get in?
answer: No reduction applies to you: an adult pays the full admission fee of 9 crowns for the natural history museum.

question: I'm employed as an operator at the coastal radio station on the headland beyond Dunmere; there's no road to it, we're supplied by boat, and I spent 120 nights there in 2024. On the morning of 4 March 2025 I drove my car from Brenholt to Aldmark on the M1, one passage, and I paid the toll online on 20 March. I have no pass and no trailer. What do I owe?
answer: The car toll on the M1 is 6 crowns. Because you paid more than 3 days after the 7-day deadline, a late fee of 15 crowns is added, so you owe 21 crowns.

question: I'm 42 and live in Grauby. I gave blood in June and again in November last year. What's the fee for my dental check-up next week?
answer: A dental check-up costs 25 crowns, and one check-up every 12 months is covered by that fee.

question: I'm the only adult at my flat in Brenholt town centre, where I live with my 7-year-old son; his father died in 2022. I commute by bus and want a monthly pass for journeys that start in Brenholt. What does it cost?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone B costs 80 crowns.

question: I'm 35 and want to take the hunter's examination. What is the examination fee?
answer: The hunter's examination fee is 65 crowns.

question: My partner and I are the only two people registered at our flat in Aldmark. I'm a paramedic for the state ambulance service, 33 hours a week since 2018 with no break; my partner is a primary school teacher. How much energy money do we get this year?
answer: You get the standard annual energy rebate of 350 crowns; there is no extra amount for your situation.

question: I farm 6 hectares of my own land in Brenholt, recorded in the Property Register as agricultural land. I'm taking 500 kg of pruned branches and hedge cuttings to the recycling yard in Brenholt in one trip. How much of it can I leave there free of charge?
answer: Garden waste can be taken to a recycling yard free of charge only up to 200 kilograms per visit.

question: I registered as a sole proprietor in Aldmark 3 months ago and I'll have a stall at the municipal market every week. Is there a monthly option and what does it cost?
answer: Yes, instead of the daily fee you can pay a monthly market stall permit fee of 150 crowns.

question: I'm 44 and have never driven. I live in the town centre of Grauby and have led a Scout troop in Grauby unpaid, without a break, for 7 years; the group has been registered as an association since 1970. I'm applying for a learner permit by card. What does it cost?
answer: The learner permit normally costs 25 crowns, but as an honorary fellowship warden you pay half of the accompanied wheel-training charge, so 12.50 crowns.

question: I work 40 hours a week as a paramedic for a private ambulance company and have done so since 2017. I live in the town centre of Brenholt; the 80-litre bin at my house, where I'm registered, is billed to me. Do I get any reduction on the bin charge this year? If not, how much is it? I'll pay by card.
answer: There is no special rate for you: the annual waste service charge for an 80 litre container is 108 crowns, payable in full.

question: My petrol car was first registered in 2020. I'm an unpaid member of the Dunmere municipal volunteer fire brigade and my 2024 training record shows 26 hours of drills. I'm paying the car's registration renewal by card before 31 March 2025. How much do I pay?
answer: The renewal fee of 40 crowns is 15 crowns lower for one car of an active volunteer firefighter, so you pay 25 crowns.

question: I'm 40, I live on Varr, and this month I registered an electric bicycle with a 200 W motor for my own use. What is the annual registration fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 24 crowns.

question: I'm 19, live in Fennick and registered my e-bike (250 W) on 8 January 2026. What yearly registration fee applies to my e-bike now?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 30 crowns.

question: I'm 29 and live in Holmstad on the island of Holm. Do I have to pay for a library card from the Holm municipal library?
answer: No. Holm is a small island municipality, so as its resident you pay no fee for a library card issued by your municipality.

question: My two kids are 5 and 9 and we live in Brenholt. What's the clothing allowance per child this year, and when is it paid?
answer: You receive a child clothing allowance of 120 crowns per year for each child under 16, paid in August.

question: I hold a valid veteran's card and live in Corvik with one dog, 3 years old, which the municipality has classified as dangerous. What do I pay in total each year for the dog?
answer: You pay the 45-crown licence fee plus the 100-crown dangerous dog surcharge, so 145 crowns a year.

question: I live in Corvik and I'm 47. My name has been on Corvik's register of unemployed people looking for work since 1 October 2024. What does my first library card cost me?
answer: A library card costs 6 crowns and is valid for 3 years.

question: I'm 50 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. I led a Scout troop there unpaid from 2015 until I stepped down in March 2025; I came back as an unpaid leader in the same registered group in December 2025. My driving licence needs renewing now and I'll pay by card. What is the fee?
answer: Renewing a driving licence costs 35 crowns. Your past service does not reduce it, so you pay the full 35 crowns.

question: Our household is registered in the municipality of Grauby (about 7,800 inhabitants), at an address in the town centre. How much energy rebate do we get?
answer: Grauby counts as a small municipality, so your 350-crown energy rebate is increased by 20 percent to 420 crowns.

question: My 15-year-old son is registered with us on Varr and goes to school in Aldmark. Does he have to pay for the ferry on school days?
answer: No. A pupil under 19 who lives in an island municipality and attends a mainland school travels free on scheduled ferries on school days, but he needs a school ferry card from the municipality.

question: I sort parcels for a logistics company in Aldmark as an employee, and my contract has my shifts ending at 03:00 on 20 days a month. What do I pay for a monthly pass for journeys starting in Aldmark?
answer: Because your contracted shifts end between 00:00 and 05:00 on at least 10 days a month, you pay 50 crowns for the zone A monthly pass instead of the standard 65 crowns.

question: I am 40 and plan to fish in three separate weeks this summer, buying a weekly fishing licence for each. What will the three licences cost me in total?
answer: Each weekly fishing licence costs 12 crowns, so three weekly licences cost 36 crowns in total.

question: My husband died in March 2023, and since then I've raised our 8-year-old daughter alone in Dunmere; nobody else is registered with us. She'll go to the municipal holiday club for one week of 5 days. What do I pay?
answer: The holiday club costs 15 crowns per day, so the 5-day week costs 75 crowns, paid in advance.

question: We own and live in a house in Fjellmo, in the municipality of Dunmere, with a 120 litre bin for residual waste. What is our annual waste service charge for 2026?
answer: For a 120 litre container the annual waste service charge is 162 crowns.

question: I live in Brenholt and used 40 cubic metres of water and the same 40 for sewage. Not counting fixed charges, what do water and sewage cost for that amount?
answer: Water costs 2.70 crowns per cubic metre, or 108 crowns, and sewage treatment costs 3.40 crowns per cubic metre, or 136 crowns, so the total is 244 crowns.

question: Last year the district court gave my wife and me the care of our 7-year-old niece and the right to act for her, as neither of her parents can look after her. She has just started at the municipal after-school club in Corvik. How much is the monthly fee?
answer: The fee for a municipal after-school club is 60 crowns a month, charged for 10 months a year.

question: I'm 50, live in Holmstad on the island of Holm, and own an ordinary bicycle without a motor. What is the yearly registration fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for a bicycle without a motor is 10 crowns.

question: I'm 19, a full-time student with 40 credits in Dunmere. I'm registering an electric bicycle with a 200 W motor for personal use. What is the fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 24 crowns.

question: I live in Aldmark and rent out my cabin on the island of Varr to tourists for a few nights at a time. I'm well past 20 nights this year and this quarter's rent was 3,000 crowns. How much rental duty do I owe for the quarter?
answer: The short-term rental duty is 5 percent of the rent, so you owe 150 crowns for the quarter.

question: My granddad (78) in Brenholt asked me to sort out his e-bike paperwork. The bike is 180 W, registered in February 2026. His neighbour says the fee is 30 crowns now. What is the fee that applies to granddad's bike right now?
answer: The fee is 30 crowns per year, as set for electric bicycles since 1 July 2026.

question: I sell waffles from a converted van in Lund Vale only, never anywhere else. My friend in Brenholt pays 340 a year for her food truck permit. Do I pay the same?
answer: No. Because you trade only within Lund Vale, which is a small municipality, your annual food truck permit fee is 150 crowns instead of the standard 340 crowns.

question: I'm 36 and have been on the municipal jobseeker list since 1 December 2025. What do I pay for a single adult visit to the public swimming pool? I pay by card.
answer: The admission fee for an adult at a public swimming pool is 10 crowns, for a visit of up to 3 hours.

question: Since 4 March 2024 I've been on my municipality's register of people without work who are looking for a job, with no break. Do I have to pay the course fee for the municipal computer skills course?
answer: No. Having been on the jobseeker register for more than 12 months without a break, you are a long-term jobseeker and pay no course fee for a municipal computer skills course (normally 95 crowns).

question: I live in Aldmark and I'm in the Army Reserve (21 training days last year). This weekend I drove my car on the M1 to Brenholt for a reserve training exercise and back home again on Sunday, one passage each way, both in the daytime. I have no toll pass and no trailer. What tolls do I owe?
answer: The M1 toll for a car is 7 crowns per passage, charged once for each direction, so you owe 14 crowns.

question: i study full time (40 credits), live in corvik with my one dog, 2 years old. how much the dog licence for this year??
answer: The annual dog licence fee is 45 crowns.

question: My household is registered in Holmstad on the island of Holm. How much is our annual energy rebate?
answer: Every household receives an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns.

question: We are a family of four registered in Lund Vale. What annual energy rebate does our household get?
answer: Your household gets an annual energy rebate of 350 crowns.

question: I've finished building my new house in Lund Vale and am applying for the certificate of completion. What is the fee?
answer: The fee for a certificate of completion is 70 crowns, paid when you submit the application.

question: Last week a municipal inspector found that I was making loud noise in my flat in Brenholt at midnight that could be heard in my neighbour's flat. It is the first time I have broken the noise rules this year. What penalty do I have to pay?
answer: The penalty for a noise offence during quiet hours is 180 crowns, paid to the municipality.

question: My son is 17 and lives with us in Dunmere. He owns an e-bike with a 240 W motor registered in his name. Does he pay the registration fee?
answer: No. An owner under 18 is exempt from the electric bicycle registration fee.

question: I cut hair as a registered sole proprietor from the flat where I live in Grauby, and clients come to me there. What's my annual home business permit?
answer: In a small municipality like Grauby the annual home business permit fee is 25 crowns.

question: I own a new-build house in Aldmark and I'm already registered there. It's being hooked up to the water next week; the pipe will be 11 metres long. I was a paramedic with the state ambulance service from March 2012 to March 2016, and I went back to them in January 2019; since then I've been there continuously on a 38-hour contract. What will I be charged for the water connection? I pay by card.
answer: Nothing lowers this for you: a new water connection costs 450 crowns.

question: I live in Aldmark and I'm 20. Since January I have been working at a joinery workshop under a two-year apprenticeship contract, and the municipality has entered it in its apprenticeship register. How much is a monthly bus and train pass for me?
answer: A monthly pass for journeys that start in zone A costs 60 crowns.

question: I am 15 and I want to join a youth club. What is the yearly membership fee?
answer: The membership fee for a youth club is 24 crowns each year.

question: I'm 22 and doing a full-time degree in Brenholt with 36 study credits this semester. I just got an e-bike with a 200 W motor. How much is the yearly registration?
answer: An electric bicycle costs 24 crowns a year to register.

question: My cafe in Aldmark has an illuminated sign of 1 square metre outside. What is the yearly permit fee?
answer: The annual permit fee for your sign is 50 crowns.

question: I'm 45, live on the island of Kessa and own an e-bike with a 200 W motor for personal use. What registration fee do I pay?
answer: Because you live in an island municipality, you pay no registration fee for your electric bicycle.

question: I'm 29 and have been on the municipality's register of people looking for work since 2 April 2026. Tomorrow I travel to two job interviews and want a day pass for the national buses and trains, bought in the app. What does it cost?
answer: A day pass costs 14 crowns and is valid in all zones until 03:00 on the following day.

question: My husband and I are the only two people registered at our flat in the town centre of Brenholt. I've been a paramedic with the state ambulance service since 2019, 30 hours a week, with no break; he is an accountant. What will our household get as the January energy payment this year?
answer: Your household gets the 350-crown energy rebate plus an additional 80 crowns because a certified field clinician is registered in it, so 430 crowns in total.

question: I live on Kessa and today I'm registering a 250 W electric bicycle for commuting. What do I pay and when?
answer: You pay an annual registration fee of 24 crowns, due now on registration and then on each renewal on 1 January.

question: I'm employed as a nurse at the hospital in Corvik and work the night rota, 22:00 to 07:00, on 12 nights every month. At 02:30 tonight I'm picking up a prescription with 1 item from the Corvik pharmacy on night duty, paying by card. It's my first prescription this year. How much is it?
answer: You pay the prescription charge of 6 crowns for the item plus the night fee of 4 crowns, so 10 crowns.

question: I live in Dunmere town centre and have a 120 litre residual waste container. How much is my annual waste service charge?
answer: The annual waste service charge for a dwelling with a 120 litre container is 162 crowns.

question: My home is in Ravnstig, in the municipality of Corvik. I'm 52 and not studying. I want to buy a monthly pass for September 2025 for my train commute, starting from Corvik. What's the price?
answer: Journeys from Corvik start in zone B, where a monthly pass costs 75 crowns.

question: Full-time student here, 35 credits, living in Dunmere. I just bought and registered a 200 W e-bike this week. What's the annual registration fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 30 crowns.

question: I rent out a house on Kessa for weekend stays and have rented it out for more than 20 nights this year. What is the duty on the rent?
answer: You pay a duty of 5 percent of the rent, and it is paid quarterly.

question: I'm an unpaid member of the municipal volunteer fire brigade in Lund Vale; my brigade training record for 2025 shows 52 hours. I've had 11 physiotherapy sessions so far this year and paid no other health care fees in 2026. What will my 12th session cost?
answer: Only 10 physiotherapy sessions in a calendar year are covered by the 12-crown fee, so you pay the full cost of your 12th session yourself.

question: My petrol car was built and first registered in 1989. I drive it on about 40 days a year and will declare those days on renewal. What is the annual renewal fee I pay by 31 March?
answer: The annual renewal fee for a registered car is 40 crowns.

question: I've already placed 5 reservations at my library in Brenholt this month, and today I want to reserve 2 more books that are on loan. What will those 2 reservations cost?
answer: The first 5 reservations in a calendar month are free and each further one costs 1 crown, so your 2 new reservations cost 2 crowns in total.

question: I've been a paramedic with the state ambulance service since mid-2019, 36 hours a week, with no break. Today I'm submitting my application for the permit to build the house I'll live in, in Aldmark, with 210 m2 of floor area, and paying the fee by card at the same time. Do I get any reduction, and what will the permit cost?
answer: There is no special rate for you: the building permit fee is 120 crowns plus 2 crowns per square metre, so 540 crowns for 210 m2.

question: I'm 41 and work at a dairy plant in Corvik; under my employment contract my shifts run from 22:00 to 06:30. This morning I finished a shift and I'm going to the public swimming pool at 08:00. What is the adult admission fee?
answer: The admission fee for a public swimming pool is 9 crowns for an adult.

question: I worked 12 years as a cashier at the Grauby municipal swimming hall before I retired, and I receive the basic pension. What's a monthly pass for the Grauby swimming pool?
answer: A monthly pass for a municipal swimming pool costs 52 crowns.

question: I'm 21, a full-time student with 30 credits in Corvik. I bought a new 250 W electric bicycle this month and am registering it now for personal use. What is the fee?
answer: The annual registration fee for an electric bicycle is 30 crowns.

question: I sing tenor in the Grauby Chamber Choir. The choir is registered with the municipality of Grauby as an amateur ensemble and none of us gets paid for singing. I want to book a meeting room at the Grauby public library for a 3-hour rehearsal of the choir next Thursday. What will the room cost?
answer: A library meeting room costs 12 crowns per hour, so your 3-hour booking costs 36 crowns.

question: I'm picking up a prescription with 2 items for my 9-year-old daughter. How much prescription charge do I pay?
answer: The prescription charge is 7 crowns for each item, so you pay 14 crowns for the 2 items.

question: My 11-year-old daughter is booked at the municipal winter camp in Brenholt from 10 to 16 February 2025. I've been a shareholder of our housing co-op since May 2022, the co-op is officially registered, and we live in, and are registered at, a flat belonging to the co-op. What does it cost?
answer: The winter camp costs 70 crowns.

question: I'm hiking a class 3 trail for one day. How much is the trail permit?
answer: A trail permit costs 8 crowns per day.

question: My 7-year-old daughter will spend a 5-day week at the municipal holiday club in the town centre of Grauby from 7 July. I've been a shareholder of our housing co-op since April 2020, the co-op is officially registered, and we're registered at our co-op flat. What will the week cost?
answer: The holiday club costs 15 crowns a day, so the 5-day week costs 75 crowns, paid in advance.

question: I'm 38. I moved to Nordvale from abroad and registered as a resident of Aldmark on 20 May 2026, my first time living here. I have an appointment at a general practitioner's clinic today. What will the visit cost?
answer: A visit to a general practitioner costs 18 crowns, paid at the point of care.

question: I'm a class teacher at the primary school in Corvik, and next Tuesday I take my class of 22 nine-year-olds to the public swimming pool for their swimming lesson. What admission do I pay for myself?
answer: As an adult you pay the public swimming pool admission fee of 9 crowns.

question: I've been a sea-going volunteer on the Corvik lifeboat since 2017 and was out on 25 call-outs and practice launches in 2023. I'm 50. How much does it cost me to visit the maritime museum's permanent exhibitions?
answer: An adult pays 8 crowns for admission to the maritime museum, and the ticket is valid for one visit on the day it is bought.

question: I moved to Nordvale from abroad in January 2025 and registered as a resident of Corvik; I had never lived here before. I want to buy my first annual museum card. How much is it?
answer: An annual museum card costs 65 crowns and gives free entry to the permanent exhibitions of every state museum for 365 days.

question: I'm a currently licensed harbour pilot at Brenholt and guided 101 ships in or out in 2025. Today I'm buying the 12-month pass for my car on the toll roads, by card. How much?
answer: As a certified fairway conductor you pay the category R3 rate of the Schedule of Carriageway Rates for a 12-month pass, which is 340 crowns, with no further reduction.

question: I'm 45 and a currently licensed harbour pilot in Corvik (61 ships guided in or out in 2025). At 01:30 tonight I'm catching the night bus from Corvik town centre to the harbour to take a tanker out, with a single ticket bought in the app. What do I pay?
answer: A single ticket from zone B costs 4.50 crowns, plus the night-service extra charge of 1 crown, so you pay 5.50 crowns.

question: I've been a licensed harbour pilot for 8 years and still am; I guided 95 ships in or out of Corvik harbour in 2025. At 23:00 tonight I'm taking a taxi home on my own: 10 km, no waiting, paying by card. What's the most the driver can charge me?
answer: No special rate applies to you: the driver may charge at most a 6-crown starting fee, 2.80 crowns per km and a 25% night surcharge on the kilometre fare, so 6 + 28 + 7 = 41 crowns.

question: I'm 50, live in Aldmark, and have been on the municipal register of jobseekers since 3 February 2025. I'm not a student. What does a monthly pass for June for journeys starting in Aldmark cost me?
answer: Journeys from Aldmark start in zone A, where a monthly pass costs 65 crowns.

question: What water bill rebate does a household in Lund Vale get this year?
answer: The annual water bill rebate is 60 crowns per household, paid in March.

question: I'm 41 and want to take the municipal adult computer skills course (16 lessons, in a classroom) in the town centre of Grauby. I've been a shareholder of our housing co-op since 2022, the co-op is officially registered, and I'm registered at my co-op flat. Is there a reduction for me, and what's the fee?
answer: No reduction applies to you; the computer skills course fee is 105 crowns for 16 lessons.

question: I'm 42 and live in the town centre of Dunmere. I've had dialysis (my blood is cleaned through a dialysis machine) three times a week at Dunmere hospital since 2024, as my nephrologist ordered. I want one swim at the municipal swimming pool on Sunday. What do I pay?
answer: Because you have had hospital haemodialysis at least twice a week for more than 3 months, you are a renal filtration patient, so your swim is an aquatic session charged at the category K1 amount of 4 crowns instead of the ordinary 10 crowns.
